sites.name: Fjallhof
sites.description: The last hold below the high fells.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Herders’ Cache
sites.description: Supplies left behind by herders who fled the trolls.

sites.name: Ice-pass
sites.description: The only way through the fell-wall. The Jarl’s dead stand in it like a door.

sites.name: Valkyrie Aerie
sites.description: A cliff-hall of the Valkyries. Frost trolls have taken it; the Valkyries circle above and will not land.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: The Troll-wife’s Hearth
sites.description: A fire in a ring of boulders. An old troll-wife tends it and watches the road.

kind.title: The Troll-wife’s Hearth
kind.text: “You threw my sons off the Valkyries’ cliff,” the troll-wife says, without getting up. “They took what was not theirs, so I will not ask for their blood. I will ask for gold, and for wood for my fire. Pay, and my kin will keep an oath with your hold. Or go to Troll-Home and take it from them — they would like that better.”

options.label: Pay the blood-price
options.summary: Pay 1,500 Gold and 10 Wood: gain the Frost Troll covenant.

options.label: Refuse — settle it at Troll-Home
options.summary: Nothing is paid. The covenant must be won at Troll-Home.

sites.name: Troll-Home
sites.description: A cave-mouth hung with antlers. The troll-wife’s sons live here.

sites.name: Ice Bridge
sites.description: A frozen waterfall wide enough to walk. The Jarl’s bridge-watch holds the far end.

sites.name: High Rune Stone
sites.description: The third stone of the oath, on the roof of the fells.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Cut the rune on the High Rune Stone? This completes The Valkyrie’s Price.

objectives.title: Break the ice-pass
objectives.description: Defeat the 16 Draugar and 6 Deathless Draugar holding the pass into the high fells.

objectives.title: Free the Valkyrie aerie
objectives.description: Drive the 5 Frost Trolls out of the Valkyries’ cliff-hall.

objectives.title: The troll-oath
objectives.description: Win the Frost Troll covenant: pay the troll-wife’s blood-price at her hearth, or beat her sons at Troll-Home.
objectives.hint: Both routes give the same covenant. The fight gives experience; the bargain saves troops. Assign the covenant to Fjallhof to build a Troll Cave.

objectives.title: A god for the fells
objectives.description: Build Hof II and commit to Thor or Tyr (20 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: Open the Pantheon screen once Hof II stands in Fjallhof. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Choosers on the wing
objectives.description: Have at least 2 Battle Valkyries in Hervor’s army.
objectives.hint: Build the Valkyrie Aerie and the Hall of the Chosen in Fjallhof; recruit or train Battle Valkyries with Hervor in town.

objectives.title: Cut the high rune
objectives.description: Cross the ice bridge and, with a god chosen and Battle Valkyries in the army, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at the High Rune Stone.

objectives.title: Herders’ cache (optional)
objectives.description: Pick up the cache the herders left when they fled.

helpTopics.title: Covenants
helpTopics.text: A covenant is a one-time entitlement. Assign it permanently to a town, then build and pay for the dwelling it unlocks.

helpTopics.title: Divine commitments
helpTopics.text: Committing to a god is player-wide and irreversible. Thor and Tyr exclude each other.

helpTopics.title: Guarded camps
helpTopics.text: A camp with a guard sells nothing until its guard is defeated.

winter_oath_m04.heroHiringDisabledReason: Hervor carries the oath alone. Hero hiring is disabled in The Winter Oath.
winter_oath_m04.name: Ice on the Sound
winter_oath_m04.subtitle: Mission 4 — Seek
winter_oath_m04.summary: Only the Norns know the Grey Jarl’s oath. Raise Lindworms, take the ice-landing, light both way-cairns through the fog and read the water of the Norns’ Well — while a draugr crew walks the ice.

briefing.speaker: Skeggi
briefing.text: Every oath ever sworn is a thread at the Norns’ well. If we want the Jarl’s, we go where the threads are.

briefing.speaker: Hervor
briefing.text: The well is at the end of the sound. The sound is ice, the ice has a fog on it, and the fog has a ship in it full of his dead.

briefing.speaker: Eydis
briefing.text: Then take the Lindworms. They see through fog. And come back before the ice does something unkind.

victory.speaker: Hervor
victory.text: His name was Hrolf. He was a king, a thousand winters ago, and he swore to hold the winter under his mound in exchange for a kingdom when it ended.

victory.speaker: Skeggi
victory.text: And the winter never ended, so the kingdom never came. He has been keeping a bargain nobody else remembers.

victory.speaker: Hervor
victory.text: Someone remembers. The water showed me a jarl in a white hall who swore to help him. Ulfhild of Hvitstrand.

lines.speaker: Bone-Helm
lines.text: The sound is ours until the thaw, seeress. And there will be no thaw.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: There — the island. And steam on the water. The well is still warm.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: Of course it is. The Norns do not care whose winter it is.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: One eye, two ravens and a grey cloak. You know who that was, Hervor. Do not tell me you do not.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: The ice took some of them through the cracks before the enemy did. I am writing them down anyway.

debriefPolicy: Hervor keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Odin and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.

sites.name: Skarvik
sites.description: A harbour-hold whose harbour is ice.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: A Fire on the Shore
sites.description: A traveller in a broad hat and a grey cloak sits by a small fire.

kind.title: The Grey Wanderer
kind.text: He has one eye and two ravens, and he knows your name before you say it. “You are going to the Well,” he says. “Good. Ask it the right question. And it is cold out on the ice — I have a spare cloak, if you have a spare seat by my fire.”

options.label: Give him your seat by the fire
options.summary: Hervor receives the Wanderer’s Grey Cloak (+2 vision, +5% daily land movement).

options.label: Trade him mead for a rune

sites.name: Frozen Knarr
sites.description: A merchant ship caught by the ice with its cargo aboard.

sites.name: Ice-landing
sites.description: The one place where the shore ice is thick enough to carry an army onto the sound.

sites.name: Ship of Nails
sites.description: A ship built from the uncut nails of the dead, frozen into the sound.

kind.title: The Ship of Nails
kind.text: Close up it is worse: every plank is nails, packed and grey. The draugr crew sailed it here and left it to wait for the thaw. Burn it, and it will never carry the dead anywhere. Or strip its iron — the smiths of Skarvik would pay well.

sites.name: Northern Way-cairn
sites.description: A way-cairn on the sea-ice. Lit, it burns through the fog-wall.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light the Northern Way-cairn? Both cairns burn through the fog-wall.

sites.name: Southern Way-cairn
sites.description: A way-cairn on the sea-ice. Lit, it burns through the fog-wall.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light the Southern Way-cairn? Both cairns burn through the fog-wall.

sites.name: Lindworm Crags
sites.description: Wingless dragons sun themselves on black crags, on beds of crystal.

sites.name: Fog-wall
sites.description: A wall of freezing fog across the sound. Both way-cairns must burn to part it.

sites.name: The Norns’ Well
sites.description: A spring that does not freeze, on an island at the end of the sound.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Read the water of the Norns’ Well? This completes Ice on the Sound.

objectives.title: Wings over the ice
objectives.description: Recruit at least 3 Lindworms in Skarvik (build the Lindworm Roost first).
objectives.hint: The Lindworm Roost needs the Valkyrie Aerie and Rune Circle I. Lindworms are the Norse shooters.

objectives.title: Take the ice-landing
objectives.description: Defeat the 20 Draugar and 8 Deathless Draugar of the nail-ship’s crew at the landing.

objectives.title: Northern way-cairn
objectives.description: Light the northern way-cairn (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Southern way-cairn
objectives.description: Light the southern way-cairn (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Burn through the fog-wall
objectives.description: With both cairns lit, the fog-wall parts.

objectives.title: The Norns’ Well
objectives.description: Defeat the wyrm brood at the Well (3 Lindworms, 1 Storm Lindworm) and pay 500 Gold and 3 Crystal to read the water.

objectives.title: Lindworm crags (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat the 2 Lindworms on the crags for 5 Crystal.

objectives.title: A grey wanderer (optional)
objectives.description: Someone has made a fire on the north shore.

helpTopics.title: The ice patrol
helpTopics.text: Bone-Helm’s crew takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and never leaves the sound between the landing and the fog-wall.

helpTopics.title: Cairns and the fog-wall
helpTopics.text: The landing reaches both cairns. Only both cairns together part the fog-wall.

helpTopics.title: Lindworms
helpTopics.text: Lindworms are the only Norse shooters. Keep them behind the draugr line and let the wolves deal with enemy archers.

winter_oath_m05.heroHiringDisabledReason: Hervor carries the oath alone. Hero hiring is disabled in The Winter Oath.
winter_oath_m05.name: The Jarl of Hvitstrand
winter_oath_m05.subtitle: Mission 5 — Contest
winter_oath_m05.summary: Jarl Ulfhild swore to keep the Grey Jarl’s winter for a frozen sea that keeps her rivals’ ships in harbour. Cross the Hvita, win a second god, take Hvitstrand from a living rival and break her oath.

briefing.speaker: Ulfhild
briefing.text: Hervor of Kaldvik. You are cutting runes all over my north. Every sea-lane you open lets my rivals’ ships out of harbour.

briefing.speaker: Hervor
briefing.text: It is not your north, Ulfhild. And people are starving behind those frozen harbours.

briefing.speaker: Ulfhild
briefing.text: People are always starving somewhere. I keep my hall full. Come and take it, if you think the gods prefer you.

victory.speaker: Hervor
victory.text: The oath-stone is cut. Ulfhild’s word holds nothing for the Grey Jarl now.

victory.speaker: Skeggi
victory.text: Then he has only his own dead left — and the giants he froze into the glacier to guard his road.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: The ford is open — both ways. Ulfhild’s riders will know it by nightfall. I am putting every spear we have on the walls.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: Freyja. Half the slain go to her hall, they say. She will want the living to fill holds again by spring.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: Heimdall, who hears the grass grow. Ulfhild will not move a sledge without our knowing.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: Hel. A hard choice, and an honest one. She knows the dead better than the Grey Jarl ever will.

lines.speaker: Ulfhild
lines.text: You should have stayed in your fjord, seeress.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: I tried. The winter would not let me.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: Hvitstrand is ours. Hang her horn in the hall — no, give it to me. A Valkyrie’s horn should not hang on a wall.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: Her people are asking what happens to them now.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: The same as ours: they eat, and the ships go out in spring.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: This is the first time we have fought the living, Hervor. Their dead will not stand up again, and neither will ours.

kind.title: Andvari’s Pool
kind.text: The ring is gold and heavy, and the water around it is warm. Skeggi will not go near it. “A dwarf cursed that ring,” he says. “It brings gold to whoever wears it, and ruin with the gold. Many have decided the gold is worth it.”

options.label: Take the ring
options.summary: Hervor receives Andvari’s Ring (+500 Gold per day, −1 Luck).

sites.name: North Ford

sites.name: South Ford
sites.description: The sledge-ford. The Grey Jarl’s dead keep it for Ulfhild.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Hvitstrand
sites.description: Jarl Ulfhild’s white hall above the frozen river-mouth.

sites.name: Ulfhild’s Oath-stone
sites.description: The stone on which Ulfhild swore to keep the Grey Jarl’s winter.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Cut the counter-rune on Ulfhild’s oath-stone? This completes The Jarl of Hvitstrand.

objectives.title: Cross the Hvita
objectives.description: Clear either ford over the frozen Hvita: the north ford (8 Frost Trolls) or the south ford (24 Draugar, 10 Deathless Draugar).
objectives.hint: Either ford is enough. Ulfhild’s war-band can use a cleared ford too.

objectives.title: A second god
objectives.description: Raise the High Hall and commit to Freyja, Heimdall or Hel (25 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: The second god needs Hof II and the High Hall in Ravnholt. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Take Hvitstrand
objectives.description: Besiege and take Jarl Ulfhild’s town of Hvitstrand.
objectives.hint: Ulfhild is a full empire run by the AI: she builds, recruits and may come for Ravnholt. Leave a garrison at home.

objectives.title: Break Ulfhild’s oath
objectives.description: With Hvitstrand taken, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal to cut the counter-rune on her oath-stone.

objectives.title: Defeat Ulfhild (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat Jarl Ulfhild’s war-band in the field.

objectives.title: Andvari’s pool (optional)
objectives.description: Something glints at the bottom of a pool that never freezes.

helpTopics.title: A rival empire
helpTopics.text: Hvitstrand is a full empire run by the AI with the same rules as yours: it builds, recruits, takes mines and may besiege Ravnholt. Losing Ravnholt does not end the mission; losing Hervor does.

helpTopics.title: The second god
helpTopics.text: A second minor god (Freyja, Heimdall or Hel) needs your first god, Hof II and the High Hall, and costs 25 Favor.

helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. Walls and towers favour the defender; Lindworms shoot over them.

winter_oath_m06.heroHiringDisabledReason: Hervor carries the oath alone. Hero hiring is disabled in The Winter Oath.
winter_oath_m06.name: The Giants’ Refuge
winter_oath_m06.subtitle: Mission 6 — Bind
winter_oath_m06.summary: The Grey Jarl froze the giants of Hrimgard into the glacier to guard his road. Climb the glacier wall, break the ice-wardens, win the Jotnar’s oath and defeat Hrafn the Hollow at the Glacier Gate.

briefing.speaker: Skeggi
briefing.text: Long before the Jarl, the giants of Hrimgard kept the winter on the glacier where it belonged. He froze them in their own hall and set his dead to watch the ice.

briefing.speaker: Hervor
briefing.text: So the winter’s old keepers are its prisoners now. Then we free them, and ask what they think of the Jarl.

briefing.speaker: Eydis
briefing.text: Ask politely. A giant’s handshake has broken better arms than yours.

victory.speaker: Jökul
victory.text: The horn has not sounded in a thousand winters, small seeress. Now the Jarl knows you are coming. So do we. We will walk with you to his door.

victory.speaker: Hervor
victory.text: Then the road is open. One hall left.

lines.speaker: Jökul
lines.text: Warm hands. I had forgotten. Who are you, to break the Jarl’s ice?

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: The one who woke his sword. I am trying to put it back to sleep.

lines.speaker: Jökul
lines.text: Then the Jotnar will swear to your hold. Claim our oath, and raise a camp where my kin can stand.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: Whatever you chose there, the giants will hear of it. Giants hear everything that happens on the ice.

lines.speaker: Hrafn
lines.text: The Valkyries chose me once. I walked out of their hall because the Jarl promised me a war that never ends. Do you know how rare that is?

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: A war that never ends is only a winter with weapons, Hrafn.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: The mail he wore came from the hall of the chosen. Sword, shield, horn — and now the mail. The Valkyries are dressing me for something.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: The glacier keeps our dead better than any barrow. I will come back for their names when it is over.

debriefPolicy: Hervor keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Odin and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the north.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and wallet.

sites.name: Jokulsby
sites.description: A shepherds’ hold under the glacier wall.

sites.name: Sawmill

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Gold Mine

sites.name: North Crossing

sites.name: South Crossing

sites.name: The Ice-bound Child
sites.description: A giant’s child, taller than a horse, frozen in a block of blue ice next to a cairn of offerings.

kind.title: The Ice-bound Child
kind.text: Someone has been leaving offerings at the child’s feet — coins, a comb, a carved horse. The ice is old, but it is only ice. With fire and patience, it would come off.

options.label: Take the offerings and go on

sites.name: Hrimgard
sites.description: The giants’ old hall, sealed in glacier ice. The Jarl’s wardens keep the ice whole.

sites.name: Storm Crags
sites.description: Storm Lindworms nest where the glacier calves into the sea.

sites.name: Glacier Gate
sites.description: An arch of black ice on the road north. Hrafn the Hollow holds it.

sites.name: Horn of Hrimgard
sites.description: A horn as long as a longship, hung in an ice-arch. Its note carries to the end of the world.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Sound the Horn of Hrimgard? This completes The Giants’ Refuge.

objectives.title: Climb onto the glacier
objectives.description: Clear either crossing of the glacier wall: north (8 Frost Trolls, 2 Ancient Frost Trolls) or south (24 Deathless Draugar, 6 Fenrir Wolves).

objectives.title: Break the ice-wardens
objectives.description: Defeat the Jarl’s wardens at Hrimgard (30 Deathless Draugar, 3 Ancient Frost Trolls, 2 Storm Lindworms) and free the frozen giants.

objectives.title: Claim the Jotunn covenant
objectives.description: Accept the giants’ oath in the journal. It can then be assigned to Jokulsby.

objectives.title: Giants in the war-band
objectives.description: Assign the covenant, build the Jotunn Camp and have at least 2 Jotnar in Hervor’s army.
objectives.hint: The Jotunn Camp needs Hof II, the Valkyrie Aerie and the assigned covenant. Recruit with Hervor in town.

objectives.title: Hrafn the Hollow
objectives.description: Defeat Hrafn and the glacier-gate guard (30 Deathless Draugar, 10 Fenrir Wolves, 4 Ancient Frost Trolls, 3 Battle Valkyries).

objectives.title: Sound the giants’ horn
objectives.description: With the gate open, pay 500 Gold and 10 Favor to sound the horn of Hrimgard and wake the road to the Jarl’s hall.

objectives.title: The ice-bound child (optional)
objectives.description: A small shape in the ice near the north crossing.

objectives.title: Storm crags (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat the 2 Storm Lindworms on the crags for 6 Crystal.

helpTopics.title: Claiming an oath
helpTopics.text: Some rewards wait in the journal until you claim them. A claimed covenant is assigned to a town on the Town screen.

helpTopics.title: Jotnar
helpTopics.text: Jotnar are slow, enormous and hard to kill. Two of them change a battle; protect them from shooters with Valkyries or wolves.

helpTopics.title: Guard commanders
helpTopics.text: A guard led by a commander fights with that commander’s attack, defense and skills, like a hero.

winter_oath_m07.heroHiringDisabledReason: Hervor carries the oath alone. Hero hiring is disabled in The Winter Oath.
winter_oath_m07.name: Oathbreaker’s Hall
winter_oath_m07.subtitle: Mission 7 — Endure
winter_oath_m07.summary: The Grey Jarl waits in his hall on the oath-mound. Climb the plateau, cut both stones to open the barrow-gate, defeat the Jarl, decide the sword’s fate and seal the oath.

briefing.speaker: The Grey Jarl
briefing.text: A thousand winters I have kept my word, seeress. A thousand. Do you know what the world was like when I swore it? Do you know what it will be like when I stop?

briefing.speaker: Hervor
briefing.text: Warmer, Hrolf.

briefing.speaker: The Grey Jarl
briefing.text: Do not use that name. Nobody has used it since my kingdom died. Come to my hall, then, and we will see whose oath is stronger.

victory.speaker: Eydis
victory.text: Hervor. The fjord is cracking. All the way to the skerries, I can hear it from the hall.

lines.speaker: Barrow Captain
lines.text: The plateau is the Jarl’s. So is everything that dies on it.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: The barrow-gate is open. I have sung about this door for forty years, and I never thought I would see it.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: Then keep your eyes open, skald. You will have to sing the rest.

lines.speaker: The Grey Jarl
lines.text: You brought my sword home. That was kind. Now kneel, and carry my winter after me.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: I brought your sword to end it. Draugar — stand with me one more time.

lines.speaker: The Grey Jarl
lines.text: A kingdom… they promised me a kingdom when the winter ended. And the winter never ended.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: It ends now. I am sorry it was not the kingdom you wanted.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: Back in its bed. The oath holds — and I hold it now. Someone has to keep the dead asleep.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: A völva keeping a king’s oath. That will make a song.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: There. No oath, no keeper, no winter held under a mound. Whatever comes now comes honestly.

lines.speaker: Skeggi
lines.text: And the dead? Every draugr in the north just heard that blade break.

lines.speaker: Hervor
lines.text: They are free. Let them decide what to do with it.

lines.speaker: Eydis
lines.text: So many, Hervor. When this is over I will cut every name into a stone of its own. A good rune, this time.

debriefPolicy: The Winter Oath is complete. Replays run in a separate practice branch and cannot change this campaign record.

sites.name: Isafold
sites.description: A hunters’ hold at the edge of the glacier plateau — the last one before the Jarl’s mound.

sites.name: Sawmill

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: North Ice-stair
sites.description: Steps cut in the ice by the Jarl’s dead.

sites.name: South Ice-stair
sites.description: Two giants who never woke, bound to the Jarl by a rune on their brows.

sites.name: North Stone
sites.description: One of the two stones that seal the barrow-gate.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Cut the counter-rune on the North Stone? Both stones open the barrow-gate.

sites.name: South Stone
sites.description: One of the two stones that seal the barrow-gate.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Cut the counter-rune on the South Stone? Both stones open the barrow-gate.

sites.name: Wyrm Crags
sites.description: Storm Lindworms circle a crag of blue crystal.

sites.name: Barrow-gate
sites.description: A door of turf and iron in the glacier. Both stones must be cut to open it.

sites.name: Grave-goods
sites.description: Tribute the Jarl’s dead brought to his door.

sites.name: Oathbreaker’s Hall
sites.description: The Grey Jarl’s hall, built on the mound where he swore his oath.

guard.label: The Grey Jarl and his hall

sites.name: The Barrow-door
sites.description: The door of the Jarl’s mound. Inside, his grave-bed is empty, with a sword-shaped hollow in the stone.

kind.title: The Sword and the Mound
kind.text: The Grey Jarl is gone, but his oath is not: it lives in the sword. Laid back in its hollow, it will keep the winter under the mound again — with a new keeper to watch it. Broken on the mound-stone, the oath ends forever, and every dead that ever answered it is free.

options.label: Return the sword
options.summary: The oath is renewed with Hervor as its keeper. Hervor gains 500 experience.

options.label: Break the sword
options.summary: The oath ends forever and the barrow-dead are free. Hervor gains 500 experience.

sites.name: The Oath-mound
sites.description: Where the oath was sworn, a thousand winters ago.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Seal the oath at the mound? This completes The Winter Oath.

objectives.title: Onto the plateau
objectives.description: Clear either crossing of the plateau wall. One is enough to reach both rune-stones.

objectives.title: The north stone
objectives.description: Cut the counter-rune on the north stone (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The south stone
objectives.description: Cut the counter-rune on the south stone (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Open the barrow-gate
objectives.description: With both stones cut, the barrow-gate opens.

objectives.title: The Grey Jarl
objectives.description: Defeat the Grey Jarl in his hall (2 Ancient Frost Trolls, 40 Deathless Draugar, 12 Fenrir Wolves, 2 Runic Jotnar, 2 Storm Lindworms).

objectives.title: The sword
objectives.description: At the barrow-door, decide what becomes of the sword.

objectives.title: Seal the oath
objectives.description: At the oath-mound, pay 1,000 Gold, 3 Crystal and 10 Favor to seal the oath and end the long winter.

objectives.title: Wyrm crags (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat the 3 Storm Lindworms on the crags for 6 Crystal.

helpTopics.title: The plateau patrol
helpTopics.text: The Barrow Captain takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and never leaves the plateau between the ice-stairs and the barrow-gate.

helpTopics.title: The two stones
helpTopics.text: Either ice-stair reaches both stones. Only both stones together open the barrow-gate.

helpTopics.title: The last choice
helpTopics.text: The sword’s fate changes the ending you see, not the reward: both choices complete the campaign.

twelfth_hour_m01.name: The Ember Dawn
twelfth_hour_m01.subtitle: Mission 1 — Restore
twelfth_hour_m01.summary: For nine mornings the sun has risen red and low and gone down again within the hour. Raise a temple guard in Abedju, clear the canal lock and sing the morning hymn at the Obelisk of the East.
newDecisions: Learn spells at the Mage Guild

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: Nine mornings, priestess. The sun climbs a hand’s breadth over the eastern hills, red as a coal, and sinks again. The fields are cold. The children have stopped asking why.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: The morning hymn is sung at the Obelisk of the East. If the hymn is not being sung, someone has stopped the singers. Raise a guard from the temple, captain — the scarab-keepers will answer.

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: Mind the canal lock on the way. Men with hidden faces have taken it. They do not rob the barges. They turn them back.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The hymn is sung. The sun stood a little higher today — not enough. Somewhere in the night, the barque that carries it has run aground.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m01.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Pawah
lines.text: Those boars were penned there. Somebody fed them at the lock and left the gate open behind them.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Then somebody wanted the barges kept away from the obelisk. That tells us where to go.

lines.speaker: Djedkhonsu
lines.text: Little reader. The hymn you came to sing is an old habit. Night has better songs.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Then let it sing them to someone who is listening.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: Their leader carried this — a temple khopesh, the sacred kind. It was stolen from the treasury at Iunu.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Keep it close. Whoever gives temple blades to hirelings has been inside the temples.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: We buried six on the canal bank today, priestess. The scarab-keepers will rise for us — but not forever.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: I know. We will spend them like silver, not like sand.

sites.name: Abedju
sites.description: Seshet’s temple-town, where the House of Life keeps the hymns of the hours.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Broken Shrine of Ra
sites.description: A wayside shrine whose offering table has been overturned.

kind.title: The Broken Shrine
kind.text: Someone has smashed the little shrine on the canal road: the offering table lies in pieces, the bread is trodden into the sand. Under the table, four bronze scarabs the size of a fist still turn slowly toward the east, waiting for a sun that does not come.

options.label: Read the morning verse over the scarabs

sites.name: Jackal Kennels
sites.description: Temple jackals that follow whoever feeds them and keeps the old words.

sites.name: Canal Lock
sites.description: The lock that lets the barges into Abedju. Boars of the marsh, driven mad by the cold, have made it their wallow.

sites.name: Abandoned Barge
sites.description: A grain barge left at the bank when its crew fled the dark mornings.

sites.name: Obelisk of the East
sites.description: The needle of stone where the morning hymn greets the sun. Masked men stand around it.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Sing the morning hymn at the Obelisk of the East? This completes The Ember Dawn.

objectives.title: Raise the temple guard
objectives.description: Recruit at least 10 Sacred Scarabs in Abedju. Starting troops and creatures that join on the map do not count.

objectives.title: Gild the scarabs
objectives.description: Build the upgraded dwelling, then train at least 8 Sacred Scarabs into Solar Scarabs.

objectives.title: Open the canal lock
objectives.description: Defeat 8 Wild Boars at Canal Lock.

objectives.title: Drive off the masked men
objectives.description: Defeat 14 Brigands, 4 Brigand Cutthroats at Obelisk of the East.

objectives.title: Sing the morning hymn
objectives.description: At Obelisk of the East, with its guard broken and both muster steps met, pay 300 Gold, 3 Stone and 1 Crystal.

objectives.title: The broken shrine (optional)
objectives.description: A wayside shrine whose offering table has been overturned.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Dwelling upgrade vs. troop training
helpTopics.text: Upgrading a dwelling unlocks the upgraded form. Training converts existing troops in town for the price difference and uses no population.

helpTopics.title: One-time choices
helpTopics.text: Some places offer a choice the first time a hero arrives. The result of each option is shown before you choose, and the choice cannot be taken back.

helpTopics.title: Afterlife
helpTopics.text: The Egyptian signature: after a battle you win, each of your stacks regains a fifth of the creatures it lost in that battle.

twelfth_hour_m02.name: The Black Boar
twelfth_hour_m02.subtitle: Mission 2 — Hunt
twelfth_hour_m02.summary: A herd of black boars, fed and driven by the Hollow Lector’s men, roots up the west-bank fields of Nekheb. Raise jackals of your own, cross the river, hunt the herd down and reopen the Shrine of the Western Gate.
newDecisions: Buy or bargain on the road

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: The west bank of Nekheb is the land of the dead — tombs, shrines, the gate the sun goes through at evening. Now a black boar runs there with its herd, and the shrine of the gate is dark.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: The black boar is an old sign. It is the shape the enemy of the sun likes best. Somebody is making signs for us to read.

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: Then we read them with jackals. Build the kennels, priestess. Jackals hunt pigs better than priests do.

victory.speaker: Pawah
victory.text: The western gate is lit again. But listen — the sun did not come back through it tonight. It has gone further in than any gate we can light from this side.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m02.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: There, below the cliffs — the fields are rooted up in a ring around the shrine. They are not eating. They are guarding.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: Then the shrine still matters to someone. Good.

lines.speaker: Djedkhonsu
lines.text: Run, black one. Run her into the sand. The night is long and she is only one reader.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: The herd is broken. The survivors ran for the cliffs.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Let them. A sign that has been read is only a pig.

sites.name: Nekheb
sites.description: A river town whose west bank is all tombs and shrines.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Vulture Crag
sites.description: From the top, the west bank lies open from the river to the cliffs.

sites.name: Amulet-maker’s Stall
sites.description: An old amulet-maker who has not closed her stall in forty years.

kind.title: The Amulet-maker
kind.text: “Forty years I have sold hearts of stone to people who were afraid of the scales,” the old woman says. “This year they buy them for the living.” She holds out a green stone scarab, warm as a hand. “Or sit, and I will tell you what the boar is, and why it wants the gate.”

options.label: Buy the heart scarab
options.summary: Pay 2,000 Gold for the Heart Scarab (+2 mana at dawn).

sites.name: Desert Kennels
sites.description: Jackals that have not joined the black herd’s masters.

sites.name: Ferry Landing
sites.description: The ferry to the west bank. The Lector’s hirelings hold the landing.

sites.name: Tomb of the Forgotten King
sites.description: An opened tomb used as a sty. Something gold glints in the dirt.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: Shrine of the Western Gate
sites.description: The shrine where the evening sun is sung into the west.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Relight the Shrine of the Western Gate? This completes The Black Boar.

objectives.title: Jackals of our own
objectives.description: Build the tier-2 dwelling in Nekheb and recruit at least 8 Jackal Guardians. Creatures bought at camps do not count.

objectives.title: Read the land from the crag
objectives.description: Climb Vulture Crag to see the land beyond the river.

objectives.title: Take the ferry landing
objectives.description: Defeat 16 Brigands, 6 Brigand Cutthroats at Ferry Landing.

objectives.title: Hunt the Black Boar
objectives.description: Catch and defeat The Black Boar (6 Great Tusked Boars, 12 Wild Boars) beyond the river.
objectives.hint: The herd roams near the middle of the west bank and only charges an escort it is sure it can beat. Move onto it to fight.

objectives.title: Relight the western gate

objectives.title: The forgotten king’s tomb (optional)

objectives.title: The amulet-maker (optional)
objectives.description: An old amulet-maker who has not closed her stall in forty years.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Wandering bands
helpTopics.text: A wandering band stays near its hunting ground, moves after your turn and attacks only an army it judges clearly weaker. Move onto it to fight it.

helpTopics.title: Lookouts
helpTopics.text: Climbing a lookout marks distant sites on your map, so you can plan a route before you can see them.

helpTopics.title: Creature camps
helpTopics.text: A camp sells its creatures to a visiting hero at their normal price. Its stock grows every week.

twelfth_hour_m03.name: The Sculptor’s Price
twelfth_hour_m03.subtitle: Mission 3 — Covenant
twelfth_hour_m03.summary: In the quarries above Edfu the tomb-servants have stopped working. Break the hired guard on the cliff road, free the sphinxes’ terrace, win the ushabti covenant — by the sculptor’s price or by force — and take a god for the long night ahead.

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: The sun’s road goes under the cliffs at Edfu. The old sculptor there still makes ushabti — the little servants who work for the dead. He says they have stopped answering.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: Ushabti answer the one who holds the covenant. If they have stopped, someone else holds it now.

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: And the sphinxes on the terrace have gone quiet too. Things are quiet all along the road, priestess. I do not like it.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The covenant holds, a god walks with us and the cliff stone is sung. The road goes down from here — into the hours where the sun is.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m03.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: The sphinxes are waking. They watched the golems the whole time — they could not move while the clay stood among them.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Then they will remember who moved the clay.

lines.speaker: Pawah
lines.text: The seal on the door — it is the Lector’s own. Djedkhonsu, the old High Lector. He taught me my letters.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: He taught me mine too. Whatever he teaches now, I will not learn it.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: A god walks with us now. Whatever waits in the hours below, we do not meet it alone.

sites.name: Edfu
sites.description: A quarry town under the great cliffs.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Quarrymen’s Cache
sites.description: Tools and silver left when the quarrymen fled.

sites.name: Cliff Road
sites.description: The only road up the cliffs, held by the Lector’s hirelings.

sites.name: Terrace of the Sphinxes
sites.description: A terrace of resting sphinxes. Clay golems stand among them like jailers.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: The Sculptor’s Workshop
sites.description: An old sculptor at his bench, surrounded by unfinished servants.

kind.title: The Sculptor’s Workshop
kind.text: “The covenant was sold,” the old sculptor says, carving. “Not by me — by the man who paid my masters more than I could. Pay me what he paid, and I will carve your name into every servant on this bench. Or go to the Sealed Workshop and take it back from his servants. They are clay; they will not mind.”

options.label: Pay the sculptor’s price
options.summary: Pay 1,500 Gold, 10 Wood: gain the covenant.

options.label: Refuse — take it at the Sealed Workshop
options.summary: Nothing is paid. The covenant must be won at Sealed Workshop.

sites.name: Sealed Workshop
sites.description: A workshop sealed with the Lector’s mark. Inside, the ushabti stand guard.

sites.name: Stone Causeway
sites.description: A causeway over the flooded quarry, held by the Lector’s cutthroats and their boars.

sites.name: Cliff Stela
sites.description: The stela where the sun’s road enters the cliff.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Sing the hymn at the Cliff Stela? This completes The Sculptor’s Price.

objectives.title: Take the cliff road
objectives.description: Defeat 16 Brigands, 6 Brigand Cutthroats at Cliff Road.

objectives.title: Free the sphinxes’ terrace
objectives.description: Drive 5 Clay Golems out of Terrace of the Sphinxes.

objectives.title: The ushabti covenant
objectives.description: Win the ushabti covenant: pay the sculptor’s price at his workshop, or break the servants at the Sealed Workshop.
objectives.hint: Both routes give the same covenant. The fight gives experience; the bargain saves troops. Assign the covenant to your town to build its dwelling.

objectives.title: A god for the night road
objectives.description: Build the Temple’s second level and commit to a first minor god (20 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: Open the Pantheon screen once the Temple stands at its second level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Great Sphinxes in the escort
objectives.description: Have at least 2 Great Sphinxes in Seshet’s army.
objectives.hint: Build the tier-4 dwelling and its upgrade, then recruit or train.

objectives.title: Sing the cliff stela
objectives.description: Cross Stone Causeway and, with a god chosen and the elite in the army, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at Cliff Stela.

objectives.title: The quarrymen’s cache (optional)
objectives.description: Tools and silver left when the quarrymen fled.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Covenants
helpTopics.text: Some dwellings need a covenant. A covenant won in a mission is assigned to a town from the journal or the town screen; the dwelling can then be built there.

helpTopics.title: The first minor god
helpTopics.text: A first minor god needs the Temple’s second level and costs 20 Favor. The choice is permanent and carries into later missions.

twelfth_hour_m04.name: The Drowned Library
twelfth_hour_m04.subtitle: Mission 4 — Seek
twelfth_hour_m04.summary: The House of Records at Per-Djehuty lies beyond the flooded marsh, behind a veil of grey mist. Raise river beasts, take the landing, light both pylon-fires to burn away the mist and read what the records say about the sun.
newDecisions: Light two fires to open a way

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: Every barque the sun has ever ridden is written down at Per-Djehuty — its crew, its road, its enemies. If anyone knows where the barque ran aground, the records do.

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: The marsh has flooded over the road and a mist has come up that does not lift. The boatmen say a drowned captain walks the islands with a drowned crew.

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: Then we go by the pylons. Light their fires and the mist burns away — the old priests built them for that.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The records are clear: the barque is held at the eleventh hour, in a hall the Lector has built inside the night. And he has a king — a vizier who crowned himself in the dusk.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m04.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: They did not bleed, priestess. They poured out water.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Then their captain is close. Keep the escort together.

lines.speaker: Pawah
lines.text: Look — the mist is burning off like morning fog. The old priests knew what they were doing.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: They always did. That is why he wants their hymns forgotten.

lines.speaker: Djedkhonsu
lines.text: You read well, little lector. Read this: no one comes back from the eleventh hour.

sites.name: Per-Djehuty
sites.description: A marsh town of scribes on the edge of the flood.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: A Scribe on a Reed Boat
sites.description: A scribe with an ibis-headed staff poles a reed boat along the bank.

kind.title: The Ibis Scribe
kind.text: He writes as he poles, and he does not look up. “You are going to the House of Records,” he says. “Good. Read the eleventh page twice. And take this — the night is long, and a priestess should not walk it with nothing but hymns.”

options.label: Take the Djed amulet
options.summary: The Djed Amulet joins Seshet’s backpack.

options.label: Ask him to teach you
options.summary: Seshet gains +1 Spell Power and +1 Knowledge.

sites.name: Sunken Grain Barge
sites.description: A grain barge sunk in the shallows; its strongbox is still above water.

sites.name: Reed Landing
sites.description: The landing on the marsh islands, held by the drowned captain’s crew.

sites.name: The Drowned Barge
sites.description: The drowned captain’s barge, beached and empty.

kind.title: The Drowned Barge
kind.text: The barge is dry inside, though it lies in the water. On the captain’s chair is a ledger: every barge he turned back, every crew he took. The last page has your name on it. Under the chair, a chest — and a crate of temple arrows the crew never used.

sites.name: North Pylon
sites.description: A pylon-fire on the northern island.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light North Pylon? Both together open Veil of Grey Mist.

sites.name: South Pylon
sites.description: A pylon-fire on the southern island.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light South Pylon? Both together open Veil of Grey Mist.

sites.name: Ogres’ Reed-hall
sites.description: Two ogres have built a hall of reeds and stolen grain.

sites.name: Veil of Grey Mist
sites.description: A wall of mist that does not move with the wind. Both pylon-fires must burn to part it.

sites.name: House of Records
sites.description: The archive of every voyage of the sun, half under water. River beasts guard its steps.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Read the records of the barque? This completes The Drowned Library.

objectives.title: River beasts of our own
objectives.description: Recruit at least 3 Crocodile Beasts in Per-Djehuty (build the tier-5 dwelling first).
objectives.hint: The tier-5 dwelling needs the tier-4 dwelling and the first level of the Mage Guild.

objectives.title: Take the reed landing
objectives.description: Defeat 20 Brigands, 8 Brigand Cutthroats at Reed Landing.

objectives.title: The north pylon
objectives.description: Light North Pylon (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The south pylon
objectives.description: Light South Pylon (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Burn away the mist
objectives.description: With both lit, Veil of Grey Mist opens.

objectives.title: Read the records
objectives.description: Defeat 3 Crocodile Beasts, 1 Sobek Warbeast at House of Records and pay 500 Gold and 3 Crystal.

objectives.title: The ogres’ reed-hall (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat 2 Ogres at Ogres’ Reed-hall.

objectives.title: The ibis scribe (optional)
objectives.description: A scribe with an ibis-headed staff poles a reed boat along the bank.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order

helpTopics.title: A commanded patrol
helpTopics.text: Ankhwen takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and keeps to the land between the two waters.

helpTopics.title: Two lights, one gate
helpTopics.text: Veil of Grey Mist opens only when both lights burn. Either order works.

twelfth_hour_m05.name: The Red Vizier
twelfth_hour_m05.subtitle: Mission 5 — Rival
twelfth_hour_m05.summary: Paser, a vizier who crowned himself in the dusk, holds Per-Wadjet and the stela of the throne. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his town and break the stela that names him king.

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: Paser was the vizier of the north. When the sun stopped, he told the people he had stopped it — that the dusk was his, and the dark lector his priest. Half the north believed him.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: The throne-stela in Per-Wadjet names him king. As long as it stands, every hymn we sing is sung to his sun.

briefing.speaker: Paser
briefing.text: Turn back, priestess. A kingdom of dusk is still a kingdom. I will rule it well.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The stela is broken and the north is free of his crown. Paser has nothing left but the Lector’s promises. Neither do we — except that we know where the barque is.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m05.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: We are over. Paser will know by tonight.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Let him. A king who has to be told he is king is already afraid.

lines.speaker: Paser
lines.text: You fight for a sun that has left you. I fight for the people who are still here.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Then you should have asked them.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: Per-Wadjet is ours. Break the stela, and the north sings our hymn again.

sites.name: Tjebu
sites.description: A town on the river road north, loyal to the old hymns.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Gold Mine
sites.description: An unowned mine. Capture for +1,000 Gold per day.

sites.name: Oasis of the Old Well
sites.description: An oasis whose well never runs dry.

kind.title: The Old Well
kind.text: At the bottom of the well something gleams — a coin, a ring, a cup — and a voice from the water says: “Take one, or leave them all and drink.”

sites.name: Golem Ford
sites.description: The northern ford, held by clay golems on Paser’s orders.

sites.name: Hireling Ford
sites.description: The southern ford, held by Paser’s hired swords.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Throne Stela
sites.description: The stela that names Paser king of the dusk.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Break the Throne Stela? This completes The Red Vizier.

sites.name: Per-Wadjet
sites.description: Paser’s capital, its walls painted red.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

objectives.title: Cross the river
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Golem Ford (8 Clay Golems) or Hireling Ford (24 Brigands, 10 Brigand Cutthroats).
objectives.hint: Either crossing is enough. Paser’s army can use a cleared crossing too.

objectives.title: A second god
objectives.description: Raise the Civic Hall’s third level and commit to a second minor god (25 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: The second god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Take Per-Wadjet
objectives.description: Besiege and take Per-Wadjet.
objectives.hint: Paser is a full empire run by the AI: it builds, recruits and may come for your town. Its town is garrisoned even when the hero rides out.

objectives.title: Break the throne stela
objectives.description: With Per-Wadjet taken, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at Throne Stela.

objectives.title: Defeat Paser (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat Paser’s army in the field.

objectives.title: The old well (optional)
objectives.description: An oasis whose well never runs dry.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: A rival empire
helpTopics.text: Per-Wadjet is a full empire run by the AI with the same rules as yours: it builds, recruits, takes mines and may besiege Tjebu. Losing Tjebu does not end the mission; losing Seshet does.

helpTopics.title: The second god
helpTopics.text: A second minor god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level, and costs 25 Favor.

helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. Walls and towers favour the defender; shooters fire over them.

twelfth_hour_m06.name: The Phoenix Rookery
twelfth_hour_m06.subtitle: Mission 6 — Refuge
twelfth_hour_m06.summary: The bennu birds, whose rising is the sun’s own, are caged in their rookery under the cliffs of Iunu. Break the jailers, accept the bennu covenant, raise firebirds of your own and defeat Hekaib at the rookery gate.
newDecisions: Claim a covenant from the journal

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: Every dawn the bennu bird rises from the fire at Iunu, and the sun follows it. Every dawn — until the Lector caged the birds.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: Free them, and the sun has wings again. Then we can follow it down.

briefing.speaker: Nebet
briefing.text: His sword holds the rookery gate. Hekaib. I trained with him, priestess. He does not lose.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The bennu fly. Tonight the sun went down in a blaze, and I saw the road it takes — down, through the hours, to the hall where the barque is held.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m06.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: The cages are open. They will not come out until they choose to — the bennu answer covenants, not keys.

lines.speaker: Pawah
lines.text: Then ask them, priestess. Politely.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: Hekaib! We stood on the same wall at Abu. Stand aside.

lines.speaker: Djedkhonsu
lines.text: He stands where I put him, captain. As you will, soon.

lines.speaker: Nebet
lines.text: He fought well. He always did. I will bury him at Abu, when this is over.

sites.name: Iunu
sites.description: The sun’s own city, dark for the first time in its history.

kind.title: The Egg of Myrrh
kind.text: The egg is myrrh, the shape of the bennu’s own, and it is warm. Carried, it will keep warm for a month. Burned, its smoke will tell you the names of the hours.

options.label: Burn it and learn the hours

sites.name: The Rookery
sites.description: The bennu cages, under the Lector’s jailers.

sites.name: Ogre Den
sites.description: Two ogre chieftains in a cave of stolen offerings.

sites.name: Rookery Gate
sites.description: The gate to the sun’s road, held by Hekaib.

sites.name: Altar of the Rising
sites.description: The altar where the bennu’s fire is lit.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Light the fire of the rising? This completes The Phoenix Rookery.

objectives.title: Climb to the rookery
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Golem Steps (8 Clay Golems, 2 Bronze Golems) or Cutthroat Stair (24 Brigand Cutthroats, 6 Great Tusked Boars).

objectives.title: Break the jailers
objectives.description: Defeat 30 Solar Scarabs, 3 Bronze Golems, 2 Sobek Warbeasts at The Rookery.

objectives.description: Accept the bennu’s covenant in the journal. It can then be assigned to Iunu.

objectives.title: Firebirds in the escort

objectives.title: Hekaib at the gate

objectives.title: Light the fire of the rising

objectives.title: The egg of myrrh (optional)
objectives.description: An egg of myrrh, warm in a bed of cold ash.

helpTopics.title: Claiming a covenant
helpTopics.text: Some rewards wait in the journal until you accept them. Accept the covenant there, then assign it to a town.

twelfth_hour_m07.name: The Twelfth Hour
twelfth_hour_m07.subtitle: Mission 7 — Finale
twelfth_hour_m07.summary: The barque of the sun is held in the Hall of the Coil, at the bottom of the night. Cross into the hours, open the gate with both horizon-stones, defeat Djedkhonsu and decide what becomes of the coiled dark.

briefing.speaker: Seshet
briefing.text: The twelfth hour. Every night the sun passes it, and every night the old priests sang it through. Djedkhonsu has built a hall across the road — and in it, something coiled, holding the barque.

briefing.speaker: Pawah
briefing.text: Two horizon-stones open the last gate, one on each side of the road. Iti the warden walks between them.

briefing.speaker: Djedkhonsu
briefing.text: Come down, then, reader. I have saved you a place in the dark.

victory.speaker: Seshet
victory.text: The barque moves. I felt it — like a held breath let go.

debriefPolicy: Seshet keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Ra and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the river.
The next mission begins with its declared escort and treasury.
twelfth_hour_m07.heroHiringDisabledReason: Seshet walks the night road with her own escort. Hero hiring is disabled in The Twelfth Hour.

lines.speaker: Pawah
lines.text: Both horizons. I have ferried the dead for fifty years, priestess, and I never thought to see both at once.

lines.speaker: Djedkhonsu
lines.text: I gave them a dusk that never ends. No scales, no judgement, no morning to fear. They should thank me.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: They wanted a morning. You never asked.

lines.speaker: Seshet
lines.text: He is gone. But the coil still holds the barque. One last thing to decide.

sites.name: Abu
sites.description: The southernmost town of the river, at the edge of the night road.

sites.name: Sawmill

sites.name: Quarry

sites.name: Western Descent
sites.description: The northern way down into the hours.

sites.name: Serpent Stair

sites.name: Stone of the Western Horizon
sites.description: The horizon where the sun sets.

sites.name: Stone of the Eastern Horizon

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Use Stone of the Eastern Horizon? Both together open Gate of the Twelfth Hour.

sites.name: Wyvern Ledge
sites.description: Wyverns roost on a ledge of the night.

sites.name: Gate of the Twelfth Hour

sites.name: Offerings of the Hours
sites.description: Offerings left by the old priests at each hour.

sites.name: Hall of the Coil
sites.description: Djedkhonsu’s hall, built across the sun’s road. Something vast is coiled in its dark.

sites.name: The Barque of the Sun
sites.description: The sun’s barque, aground on a coil of the dark.

kind.title: The Coil and the Barque
kind.text: With the Lector fallen, only the coil holds the barque: a loop of the dark as thick as a temple column. Sung down, it can be bound under the hall again — the old way, with a priestess to renew the binding every year. Cut, it will never hold anything again; but the night will be a little wilder ever after, without its old enemy to fight.

options.label: Bind the coil
options.summary: The coil is bound under the hall, with Seshet as its keeper. Seshet gains 500 experience.

options.label: Cut the coil
options.summary: The coil is cut and gone forever; the night grows wilder. Seshet gains 500 experience.

sites.name: The Twelfth Gate
sites.description: The doorway of the dawn.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Sing the barque through the twelfth gate? This completes The Twelfth Hour.

objectives.title: Down into the hours
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Western Descent (30 Solar Scarabs, 6 Anubian Wardens) or Serpent Stair (2 Basilisks, 12 Solar Scarabs). One is enough to reach both stones.

objectives.title: The western horizon
objectives.description: Use Stone of the Western Horizon (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The eastern horizon
objectives.description: Use Stone of the Eastern Horizon (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Open the twelfth gate
objectives.description: With both stones used, Gate of the Twelfth Hour opens.

objectives.title: The Hollow Lector
objectives.description: Defeat Djedkhonsu at Hall of the Coil (2 Bronze Golems, 40 Solar Scarabs, 12 Anubian Wardens, 2 Greater Basilisks, 2 Sobek Warbeasts).

objectives.title: The coil
objectives.description: At The Barque of the Sun, decide.

objectives.title: Sing the barque home
objectives.description: At The Twelfth Gate, pay 1,000 Gold, 3 Crystal and 10 Favor.
