lantern_road_m01.name: The Unlit Lantern
lantern_road_m01.subtitle: Mission 1 — Restore
lantern_road_m01.summary: On the night of the festival of the dead, not one lantern in Kagaribi would light. Raise a fox retinue, clear the bamboo bridge and relight the great stone lantern on the pass.
newDecisions: Learn spells at the Mage Guild

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: Every lantern, priestess. The paper ones, the stone ones, the ones in the river. The dead came down the mountain to find their way home and found nothing but dark.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: Then they are still out there, wandering. The great lantern on the pass lights all the others. If it is dark, someone put it out.

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: Men with straw hats and long blades have been seen on the pass road. And the boars have taken the bamboo bridge. I would not go alone.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The great lantern burns, and one by one the little ones are catching. But only here. Beyond the mountains the road is still dark.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m01.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: Those boars were tied to the bridge posts. Someone wanted the road closed.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Then someone is afraid of what the lantern shows.

lines.speaker: Yamikage
lines.text: Little diviner. Light is a meal, and I am very hungry. Leave the lantern to me.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Go hungry, then.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Their leader wore this — a dragon helm from the Kumoyama shrine treasury.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Stolen from a shrine and worn by a bandit. Whoever pays these men has been inside our shrines.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: We lost foxes today, priestess. Foxes remember.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: So do I. We will be more careful.

sites.name: Kagaribi
sites.description: Akane’s shrine-town, famous for its festival lanterns.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Abandoned Tea House
sites.description: A roadside tea house whose keeper fled in the night.

kind.title: The Abandoned Tea House
kind.text: The kettle is still warm. The keeper left in such a hurry that the till is full — and four small foxes sit in a row on the veranda, as if waiting for someone to tell them where to go.

options.label: Ask the foxes to follow you

sites.name: Kappa Pool
sites.description: River kappa who will serve anyone polite enough to bow first.

sites.name: Bamboo Bridge
sites.description: The bridge to the pass road. Wild boars, maddened by the dark nights, hold it.

sites.name: Pilgrim’s Shelter
sites.description: A shelter where pilgrims left offerings for the road.

sites.name: Great Lantern of the Pass
sites.description: The stone lantern that lights the spirits’ road. Ronin in straw hats stand around it.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Relight the Great Lantern of the Pass? This completes The Unlit Lantern.

objectives.title: Gather the fox retinue
objectives.description: Recruit at least 10 Kitsune in Kagaribi. Starting troops and creatures that join on the map do not count.

objectives.title: Teach the foxes their tails
objectives.description: Build the upgraded dwelling, then train at least 8 Kitsune into Nine-Tailed Kitsune.

objectives.title: Clear the bamboo bridge
objectives.description: Defeat 8 Wild Boars at Bamboo Bridge.

objectives.title: Drive off the ronin
objectives.description: Defeat 14 Brigands, 4 Brigand Cutthroats at Great Lantern of the Pass.

objectives.title: Relight the great lantern
objectives.description: At Great Lantern of the Pass, with its guard broken and both muster steps met, pay 300 Gold, 3 Stone and 1 Crystal.

objectives.title: The abandoned tea house (optional)
objectives.description: A roadside tea house whose keeper fled in the night.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Dwelling upgrade vs. troop training
helpTopics.text: Upgrading a dwelling unlocks the upgraded form. Training converts existing troops in town for the price difference and uses no population.

helpTopics.title: One-time choices
helpTopics.text: Some places offer a choice the first time a hero arrives. The result of each option is shown before you choose, and the choice cannot be taken back.

helpTopics.title: Harmony
helpTopics.text: The Japanese signature: with creatures of three or more different families in the army, every stack gains +1 Defense when a battle starts.

lantern_road_m02.name: The Boar Lord
lantern_road_m02.subtitle: Mission 2 — Hunt
lantern_road_m02.summary: A giant boar and its herd run the rice terraces of Mizuhara and keep the spirits from the river lantern. Raise kappa of your own, cross the river, hunt the Boar Lord and relight the lantern of the mountain road.
newDecisions: Buy or bargain on the road

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: Mizuhara’s terraces are ruined. A boar as big as an ox runs there with a herd at its back, and it does not eat the rice. It tramples it.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: A beast that wastes food is a beast someone has sent. The river lantern is beyond the terraces — and it is dark.

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: Kappa, priestess. Kappa know the river, and boars do not swim.

victory.speaker: Genzo
victory.text: Two lanterns lit. Now the old monks say the Crow Monastery on the high pass has stopped ringing its bell. That is where the road climbs next.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m02.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: There — the terraces are trampled in a ring around the river lantern. They are not feeding. They are guarding it.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Then it still matters to somebody.

lines.speaker: Yamikage
lines.text: Trample her, great one. Trample her into the mud with the rice.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: The Boar Lord is down. The herd is scattering into the cedars.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Let them go. Without their lord they are only pigs.

sites.name: Mizuhara
sites.description: A village of rice terraces on the river.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Pagoda of Five Roofs
sites.description: From its top roof, the land beyond the river lies open.

sites.name: Clog-maker’s Workshop
sites.description: A clog-maker who once made shoes for a tengu.

kind.title: The Clog-maker
kind.text: “A tengu came to me once for shoes,” the old man says. “He paid in feathers. I kept one pair for myself — one tooth, very tall. Walk in them and the road is shorter.” He sets them on the bench. “Or sit, and I will tell you what the tengu told me about boars.”

options.label: Buy the tengu clogs
options.summary: Pay 2,000 Gold for the Tengu Geta.

sites.name: Reed Pool
sites.description: Kappa who have not fled the boars.

sites.name: Plank Bridge
sites.description: The bridge over the river, held by ronin.

sites.name: Boar Wallow
sites.description: A muddy hollow under the cedars, where something bright lies trampled into the mud.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: River Lantern
sites.description: The lantern of the mountain road, standing in the river shallows.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Relight the River Lantern? This completes The Boar Lord.

objectives.title: Kappa of our own
objectives.description: Build the tier-2 dwelling in Mizuhara and recruit at least 8 Kappa. Creatures bought at camps do not count.

objectives.title: Climb the pagoda
objectives.description: Climb Pagoda of Five Roofs to see the land beyond the river.

objectives.title: Take the plank bridge
objectives.description: Defeat 16 Brigands, 6 Brigand Cutthroats at Plank Bridge.

objectives.title: Hunt the Boar Lord
objectives.description: Catch and defeat The Boar Lord (6 Great Tusked Boars, 12 Wild Boars) beyond the river.
objectives.hint: The herd roams the terraces beyond the river and only charges a retinue it is sure it can beat. Move onto it to fight.

objectives.title: Relight the river lantern
objectives.description: With The Boar Lord broken, pay 400 Gold, 4 Stone and 1 Crystal at River Lantern.

objectives.title: The boar wallow (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat 4 Great Tusked Boars, 6 Wild Boars at Boar Wallow.

objectives.title: The clog-maker (optional)
objectives.description: A clog-maker who once made shoes for a tengu.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Wandering bands
helpTopics.text: A wandering band stays near its hunting ground, moves after your turn and attacks only an army it judges clearly weaker. Move onto it to fight it.

helpTopics.title: Lookouts
helpTopics.text: Climbing a lookout marks distant sites on your map, so you can plan a route before you can see them.

helpTopics.title: Creature camps
helpTopics.text: A camp sells its creatures to a visiting hero at their normal price. Its stock grows every week.

lantern_road_m03.name: The Crow Monastery
lantern_road_m03.subtitle: Mission 3 — Covenant
lantern_road_m03.summary: The bell of the Crow Monastery on Kumoyama has stopped. Break the ronin on the mountain road, free the oni of the red hall from their clay jailers, win the tengu covenant — by the abbot’s price or by force — and take a kami for the road ahead.

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: The tengu of Kumoyama keep the bell that wakes the mountain road. The bell has been silent for a month.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: Tengu ring for whoever holds their covenant. If the bell is silent, someone else holds it.

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: And the red oni in the old hall have stopped coming down to drink. Oni always come down to drink.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The bell rings, a kami walks with us and the mountain road is lit. From here the road goes down to the sea.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m03.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: The oni are awake and very thirsty. They say they will remember who broke the clay.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Good. I want them to remember.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: The paper on the wall — the covenant. It is signed with a lantern, burned through the middle.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: A lantern with its light eaten out. I know that mark now.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: A kami walks with us. Whatever eats the light, it will not find us alone in the dark.

sites.name: Kumoyama
sites.description: A mountain town below the Crow Monastery.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Pilgrims’ Storehouse
sites.description: Rice and silver left by pilgrims who turned back.

sites.name: Mountain Road
sites.description: The only road up the mountain, held by ronin.

sites.name: Hall of the Red Oni
sites.description: An old hall where oni drink and sleep. Haniwa — clay tomb-figures — stand at its doors like jailers.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: The Abbot’s Gate
sites.description: The tengu abbot sits on the monastery gate, long-nosed and patient.

kind.title: The Tengu Abbot
kind.text: “Our covenant was bought,” the abbot says, “by a man with a lantern for a face. Bought, not won — so it can be bought back. Pay what he paid, and the bell is yours. Or climb to the Crow Hall and take it from my monks. They have been bored since the bell stopped.”

options.label: Pay the abbot’s price
options.summary: Pay 1,500 Gold, 10 Wood: gain the covenant.

options.label: Refuse — take it at the Crow Hall
options.summary: Nothing is paid. The covenant must be won at Crow Hall.

sites.name: Crow Hall
sites.description: The tengu monks’ hall, where the bought covenant hangs on the wall.

sites.name: Rope Bridge
sites.description: A rope bridge over the gorge, held by ronin and their boars.

sites.name: Mountain Lantern
sites.description: The lantern where the spirits’ road crosses the summit.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Relight the Mountain Lantern? This completes The Crow Monastery.

objectives.title: Take the mountain road
objectives.description: Defeat 16 Brigands, 6 Brigand Cutthroats at Mountain Road.

objectives.title: Free the red oni
objectives.description: Drive 5 Clay Golems out of Hall of the Red Oni.

objectives.title: The tengu covenant
objectives.description: Win the tengu covenant: pay the abbot’s price at the gate, or beat his monks at the Crow Hall.
objectives.hint: Both routes give the same covenant. The fight gives experience; the bargain saves troops. Assign the covenant to your town to build its dwelling.

objectives.title: A kami for the road
objectives.description: Build the Temple’s second level and commit to a first minor god (20 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: Open the Pantheon screen once the Temple stands at its second level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Oni warlords in the retinue
objectives.description: Have at least 2 Oni Warlords in Akane’s army.
objectives.hint: Build the tier-4 dwelling and its upgrade, then recruit or train.

objectives.title: Relight the mountain lantern
objectives.description: Cross Rope Bridge and, with a god chosen and the elite in the army, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at Mountain Lantern.

objectives.title: The pilgrims’ storehouse (optional)
objectives.description: Rice and silver left by pilgrims who turned back.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Covenants
helpTopics.text: Some dwellings need a covenant. A covenant won in a mission is assigned to a town from the journal or the town screen; the dwelling can then be built there.

helpTopics.title: The first minor god
helpTopics.text: A first minor god needs the Temple’s second level and costs 20 Favor. The choice is permanent and carries into later missions.

lantern_road_m04.name: The Spirit Sea
lantern_road_m04.subtitle: Mission 4 — Seek
lantern_road_m04.summary: The Hall of Mirrors stands on an island in the Spirit Sea, behind a fog that eats boats. Raise spider-women of your own, take the landing, ring both shrine bells to clear the fog and look into the mirrors for the Lantern-Eater’s home.
newDecisions: Ring two bells to open a way

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: The Hall of Mirrors shows what has been hidden. If anything knows where the Lantern-Eater sleeps, the mirrors do.

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: The fog came in when the lanterns went out, and a fleet sails in it — ships with no lights. Their captain walks the islands.

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: Two shrine bells, one on each island. Ring them both and the fog has to listen.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The mirrors showed me: a palace at the end of the road, where the last torii stands. And a lord of iron between here and there, who fences the wandering dead into his army.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m04.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: No lamps on any of their boats. They sail by smell.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Then their captain is close. Keep the retinue together.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Listen — the fog is leaving like a guest who was told the party is over.

lines.speaker: Yamikage
lines.text: Look into my mirrors, diviner. You will see the dark — and the dark will see you.

sites.name: Shiogama
sites.description: A salt-makers’ harbour on the Spirit Sea.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: A Wandering Monk
sites.description: A monk in a basket hat, playing a flute on the shore.

kind.title: The Flute-playing Monk
kind.text: He stops playing when you come near. “You are going to the mirrors,” he says. “Look twice — the first look shows you what you want to see.” He holds out a travelling cloak, salt-stiff. “The sea wind is cold. Or sit, and I will teach you a tune that fog does not like.”

options.label: Take the cloak
options.summary: The Wayfarer’s Cloak joins Akane’s backpack.

options.label: Learn the tune
options.summary: Akane gains +1 Spell Power and +1 Knowledge.

sites.name: Beached Salt Boat
sites.description: A salt boat driven ashore by the fog; its strongbox is dry.

sites.name: Island Landing
sites.description: The landing on the near island, held by the fog fleet’s raiders.

sites.name: The Lightless Ship
sites.description: A ship of the fog fleet, aground and empty.

kind.title: The Lightless Ship
kind.text: Every lamp on the ship has been emptied — the oil drunk, not spilled. In the captain’s cabin, a chest of silver and a rack of kappa-skin raincoats.

options.label: Give the raincoats to the kappa
options.summary: 6 River Elder Kappa join Akane’s retinue.

sites.name: North Shrine Bell
sites.description: A shrine bell on the northern island.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light North Shrine Bell? Both together open Wall of Fog.

sites.name: South Shrine Bell
sites.description: A shrine bell on the southern island.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light South Shrine Bell? Both together open Wall of Fog.

sites.name: Ogre Grotto
sites.description: Two ogres sleep in a sea cave full of stolen nets.

sites.name: Wall of Fog
sites.description: A wall of fog that eats boats. Both shrine bells must ring to clear it.

sites.name: Hall of Mirrors
sites.description: A hall of bronze mirrors on the far island. Spider-women weave over its doors.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Look into the mirrors? This completes The Spirit Sea.

objectives.title: Spider-women of our own
objectives.description: Recruit at least 3 Jorogumo in Shiogama (build the tier-5 dwelling first).
objectives.hint: The tier-5 dwelling needs the tier-4 dwelling and the first level of the Mage Guild.

objectives.title: Take the island landing
objectives.description: Defeat 20 Brigands, 8 Brigand Cutthroats at Island Landing.

objectives.title: The north bell
objectives.description: Light North Shrine Bell (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The south bell
objectives.description: Light South Shrine Bell (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Clear the fog
objectives.description: With both lit, Wall of Fog opens.

objectives.title: Look into the mirrors
objectives.description: Defeat 3 Jorogumo, 1 Queen Jorogumo at Hall of Mirrors and pay 500 Gold and 3 Crystal.

objectives.title: The ogre grotto (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat 2 Ogres at Ogre Grotto.

objectives.title: The flute-playing monk (optional)
objectives.description: A monk in a basket hat, playing a flute on the shore.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: A commanded patrol
helpTopics.text: Gonryō takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and keeps to the land between the two waters.

helpTopics.title: Two lights, one gate
helpTopics.text: Wall of Fog opens only when both lights burn. Either order works.

lantern_road_m05.name: The Iron Daimyo
lantern_road_m05.subtitle: Mission 5 — Rival
lantern_road_m05.summary: Lord Kurogane fences the wandering dead into his army and holds the Iron Castle and the Lantern of Oaths. Cross the river, take a second kami, besiege his castle and break the lantern that binds the dead to him.

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: Kurogane rounds up the wandering dead like stray horses and puts them in his army. He says they are loyal. They are only lost.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: The Lantern of Oaths in his castle binds them to him. While it burns, every spirit he catches is his.

briefing.speaker: Kurogane
briefing.text: Turn back, diviner. The dead need a lord as much as the living do. I am a good one.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The Lantern of Oaths is out and the dead he bound are walking home. Kurogane has nothing left but the Lantern-Eater’s promises.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m05.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: We are over. His scouts will be riding back already.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Let them ride. I want him to know who is coming.

lines.speaker: Kurogane
lines.text: Every spirit you send home is a soldier I lose. Is that fair?

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: They were never yours to lose.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: The Iron Castle is ours. Now the lantern.

sites.name: Akashi
sites.description: A river town on the road north, loyal to the shrines.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Gold Mine
sites.description: An unowned mine. Capture for +1,000 Gold per day.

sites.name: Hot Spring
sites.description: A hot spring with a little shrine above it.

kind.title: The Hot Spring
kind.text: A monkey sits in the spring and watches you over the steam. On the shrine shelf lie a purse of offerings — and a cup, for whoever will drink from the spring instead.

sites.name: Haniwa Ford
sites.description: The northern ford, held by clay figures on Kurogane’s orders.

sites.name: Ronin Ford
sites.description: The southern ford, held by Kurogane’s ronin.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Lantern of Oaths
sites.description: The lantern that binds the wandering dead to Kurogane.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Put out the Lantern of Oaths? This completes The Iron Daimyo.

sites.name: Iron Castle
sites.description: Kurogane’s castle, roofed in black iron.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

objectives.title: Cross the river
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Haniwa Ford (8 Clay Golems) or Ronin Ford (24 Brigands, 10 Brigand Cutthroats).
objectives.hint: Either crossing is enough. Kurogane’s army can use a cleared crossing too.

objectives.title: A second kami
objectives.description: Raise the Civic Hall’s third level and commit to a second minor god (25 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: The second god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Take the Iron Castle
objectives.description: Besiege and take Iron Castle.
objectives.hint: Kurogane is a full empire run by the AI: it builds, recruits and may come for your town. Its town is garrisoned even when the hero rides out.

objectives.title: Put out the Lantern of Oaths
objectives.description: With Iron Castle taken, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at Lantern of Oaths.

objectives.title: Defeat Kurogane (optional)
objectives.description: Defeat Kurogane’s army in the field.

objectives.title: The hot spring (optional)
objectives.description: A hot spring with a little shrine above it.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: A rival empire
helpTopics.text: Iron Castle is a full empire run by the AI with the same rules as yours: it builds, recruits, takes mines and may besiege Akashi. Losing Akashi does not end the mission; losing Akane does.

helpTopics.title: The second god
helpTopics.text: A second minor god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level, and costs 25 Favor.

helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. Walls and towers favour the defender; shooters fire over them.

lantern_road_m06.name: The Kirin Meadow
lantern_road_m06.subtitle: Mission 6 — Refuge
lantern_road_m06.summary: The kirin, whose coming marks a just age, are penned in their high meadow by the Lantern-Eater’s jailers. Break the jailers, accept the kirin covenant, raise kirin of your own and defeat General Oboro at the meadow gate.
newDecisions: Claim a covenant from the journal

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: The kirin only walk where a just ruler reigns. For a year no one has seen one. The herders say they are penned in the high meadow, like cattle.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: Free them, and the land remembers what justice looks like. Then the last road opens.

briefing.speaker: Shiro
briefing.text: The meadow gate is held by Oboro, the general of the hazy moon. Nobody has seen his face. Nobody has seen him lose.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The kirin walk again. Tonight I saw the last part of the road from the meadow — the sun stone, the moon stone and the last torii between them.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m06.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: The pens are open. The kirin will not follow us for being freed — they follow a covenant, or nothing.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: Then offer them one, priestess. They are listening.

lines.speaker: Yamikage
lines.text: Oboro, my general, has never shown his face. Shall I tell you why? There is no face. Only my hunger, wearing armour.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: The armour is empty. There really was no one inside.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: Then there is one less thing to bury.

sites.name: Takamori
sites.description: A high town on the edge of the kirin meadows.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Gold Mine
sites.description: An unowned mine. Capture for +1,000 Gold per day.

sites.name: Haniwa Steps
sites.description: The northern steps to the meadow, held by clay figures.

sites.name: Ronin Stair
sites.description: The southern stair, held by ronin and their boars.

sites.name: A Kirin Foal
sites.description: A kirin foal caught in a herder’s fence.

kind.title: The Kirin Foal
kind.text: The foal’s scales are the colour of new bronze. Cut free, it will remember you. Or the herder will trade you its shed horn-tip, which glows a little in the dark — he found it in the fence this morning.

sites.name: Kirin Pens
sites.description: The pens where the kirin are held, under the Lantern-Eater’s jailers.

sites.name: Ogre Shelter
sites.description: Two ogre chieftains in a shelter of stolen saddles.

sites.name: Meadow Gate
sites.description: The gate to the last road, held by General Oboro.

sites.name: Drum of the Just Age
sites.description: The great drum the herders beat when the kirin come.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Beat the Drum of the Just Age? This completes The Kirin Meadow.

objectives.title: Climb to the meadow
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Haniwa Steps (8 Clay Golems, 2 Bronze Golems) or Ronin Stair (24 Brigand Cutthroats, 6 Great Tusked Boars).

objectives.title: Break the pen jailers
objectives.description: Defeat 30 Nine-Tailed Kitsune, 3 Bronze Golems, 2 Queen Jorogumo at Kirin Pens.

objectives.title: Accept the kirin covenant

objectives.title: Kirin in the retinue
objectives.description: Assign the covenant, build the tier-6 dwelling and have at least 2 Kirin in Akane’s army.
objectives.hint: The tier-6 dwelling needs the Temple’s second level, the tier-4 dwelling and the assigned covenant.

objectives.title: General Oboro at the gate
objectives.description: Defeat Oboro and the gate guard (30 Nine-Tailed Kitsune, 10 River Elder Kappa, 4 Great Tengu, 3 Oni Warlords).

objectives.title: Beat the drum of the just age
objectives.description: With the gate open, pay 500 Gold and 10 Favor at Drum of the Just Age.

objectives.title: The kirin foal (optional)
objectives.description: A kirin foal caught in a herder’s fence.

helpTopics.title: Claiming a covenant
helpTopics.text: Some rewards wait in the journal until you accept them. Accept the covenant there, then assign it to a town.

lantern_road_m07.name: The Last Torii
lantern_road_m07.subtitle: Mission 7 — Finale
lantern_road_m07.summary: The Lantern-Eater’s palace stands across the last stretch of the spirits’ road, behind the last torii. Cross the hills, light the sun stone and the moon stone, defeat Yamikage and decide what becomes of the road between the worlds.

briefing.speaker: Akane
briefing.text: The last torii. Every spirit that ever went home went through it. Yamikage has built his palace across the road beyond it, and eats every light that comes near.

briefing.speaker: Genzo
briefing.text: The sun stone and the moon stone open the torii, one on each side of the valley. A warden walks between them — Kagerō.

briefing.speaker: Yamikage
briefing.text: Come and be eaten, little light. You have been delicious so far.

victory.speaker: Akane
victory.text: The road is open. I can see them — thousands of little lights, walking home.

debriefPolicy: Akane keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Amaterasu and every kami she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, towns, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to guard the road.
The next mission begins with its declared retinue and treasury.
lantern_road_m07.heroHiringDisabledReason: Akane walks the lantern road with her own retinue. Hero hiring is disabled in The Lantern Road.

lines.speaker: Genzo
lines.text: The torii is open. My grandfather carved lanterns for sixty years and never saw it with his own eyes.

lines.speaker: Yamikage
lines.text: Every light ends, diviner. I only end them sooner.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: And every dark ends at morning. I am here to make it sooner.

lines.speaker: Akane
lines.text: He is gone. The road is still here. Now — how should it be lit?

sites.name: Hikari
sites.description: The last town before the spirits’ road, where the lantern-makers live.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Northern Torii Path
sites.description: The northern path up into the hills.

sites.name: Southern Torii Path
sites.description: The southern path, where two penned kirin stand guard against their will.

sites.name: Sun Stone
sites.description: The stone of the day.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Use Sun Stone? Both together open The Last Torii.

sites.name: Moon Stone
sites.description: The stone of the night.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Use Moon Stone? Both together open The Last Torii.

sites.name: Wyvern Crags
sites.description: Wyverns roost above the torii path.

sites.name: The Last Torii
sites.description: The last gate of the spirits’ road. Both stones must be lit to open it.

sites.name: Lantern-makers’ Offerings
sites.description: Offerings left at the torii by generations of lantern-makers.

sites.name: Palace of the Lantern-Eater
sites.description: A palace built across the spirits’ road, dark as an empty lantern.

sites.name: The Road Between Worlds
sites.description: The spirits’ road, where it passes the fallen palace.

kind.title: The Road Between Worlds
kind.text: With Yamikage gone, the road is yours to set. Lit with lanterns again, it will be what it always was: one night a year for the dead to come home and go back. Left open, with no lanterns at all, the spirits will choose their own times and ways — a stranger world, and a less lonely one.

options.label: Light the lanterns
options.summary: The road is lit the old way, one night a year. Akane gains 500 experience.

options.label: Leave the road open
options.summary: The spirits choose their own ways. Akane gains 500 experience.

sites.name: First Lantern
sites.description: The first lantern of the road, where every festival begins.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Light the first lantern of the road? This completes The Lantern Road.

objectives.title: Into the hills
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Northern Torii Path (30 Nine-Tailed Kitsune, 6 River Elder Kappa) or Southern Torii Path (2 Kirin, 12 Nine-Tailed Kitsune). One is enough to reach both stones.

objectives.title: Light the sun stone
objectives.description: Use Sun Stone (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Light the moon stone
objectives.description: Use Moon Stone (300 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: Open the last torii
objectives.description: With both stones used, The Last Torii opens.

objectives.title: The Lantern-Eater
objectives.description: Defeat Yamikage at Palace of the Lantern-Eater (2 Great Tengu, 40 Nine-Tailed Kitsune, 12 River Elder Kappa, 2 Celestial Kirin, 2 Queen Jorogumo).

objectives.title: The road between worlds
objectives.description: At The Road Between Worlds, decide.

objectives.title: Light the first lantern
objectives.description: At First Lantern, pay 1,000 Gold, 3 Crystal and 10 Favor.

helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: The patrol
helpTopics.text: Kagerō takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and never leaves the land between the crossings and the gate.

helpTopics.title: The two stones
helpTopics.text: Either crossing reaches both stones. Only both stones together open The Last Torii.

helpTopics.title: The last choice
helpTopics.text: The last choice changes the ending you see, not the reward: both complete the campaign.

silver_branch_m01.name: The Cold Hearth
silver_branch_m01.subtitle: Mission 1 — Restore
silver_branch_m01.summary: Beltane came and no fire would catch. Raise a war-band of pooka in Dún Caill, clear the ford of the alders and light the Beltane fire on the old stone.
newDecisions: Learn spells at the Mage Guild

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: Beltane, and the cattle still in the byres. We built the fire twice and it would not take. The kindling was dry as bone.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: Then the fire is not refusing the kindling. Something is refusing the summer. The Beltane stone on the ridge is where the year turns — I need to see it.

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: Reavers have been seen on the ridge. And the boars have taken the alder ford. Bring the pooka — they are quicker than men.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The fire caught. The cattle went out between the flames this morning. But only here — over the hills the dark half holds.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m01.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: Someone threw grain into that ford every night. You do not keep boars by accident.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Then someone wanted the ridge kept quiet. The stone, then.

lines.speaker: Dubhghall
lines.text: Little druid. The summer is over. I have seen to it. Go home and sleep until spring — there will not be one.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: I have never been good at sleeping.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: Their chief wore this — a mistletoe crown from the grove at Dún Bera.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: A grove-crown on a reaver. Whoever pays them has walked in the groves.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: We buried some of ours under the alders today, Orla.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: I know. We will not leave more there than we have to.

sites.name: Dún Caill
sites.description: Orla’s hillfort by the hazel grove.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: The Hawthorn Well
sites.description: A holy well under a lone hawthorn, its rags faded.

kind.title: The Hawthorn Well
kind.text: The well is choked with offerings — coins, pins, a silver brooch — left by people who wanted the summer back. In the hawthorn above it four hares watch you without blinking, the way no hare should.

sites.name: Cú Sith Den
sites.description: Great green hounds of the hills that will run with a druid.

sites.name: Ford of the Alders
sites.description: The ford to the ridge road. Boars, wild with the cold, wallow in it.

sites.name: Herders’ Booley
sites.description: A summer hut the herders never reached this year.

sites.name: Beltane Stone
sites.description: The stone on the ridge where the year turns. Reavers camp around it.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Light the Beltane fire on the stone? This completes The Cold Hearth.

objectives.title: Gather the pooka
objectives.description: Recruit at least 10 Pooka in Dún Caill. Starting troops and creatures that join on the map do not count.

objectives.title: Teach the old shapes
objectives.description: Build the upgraded dwelling, then train at least 8 Pooka into Elder Pooka.

objectives.title: Clear the alder ford
objectives.description: Defeat 8 Wild Boars at Ford of the Alders.

objectives.title: Drive off the reavers
objectives.description: Defeat 14 Brigands, 4 Brigand Cutthroats at Beltane Stone.

objectives.title: Light the Beltane fire
objectives.description: At Beltane Stone, with its guard broken and both muster steps met, pay 300 Gold, 3 Stone and 1 Crystal.

objectives.title: The hawthorn well (optional)
objectives.description: A holy well under a lone hawthorn, its rags faded.

helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Dwelling upgrade vs. troop training
helpTopics.text: Upgrading a dwelling unlocks the upgraded form. Training converts existing troops in town for the price difference and uses no population.

helpTopics.title: One-time choices
helpTopics.text: Some places offer a choice the first time a hero arrives. The result of each option is shown before you choose, and the choice cannot be taken back.

helpTopics.title: Shapeshifting
helpTopics.text: The Celtic signature: creatures with Shapeshift change aspect at the start of their activation for free.

silver_branch_m02.name: The Iron-Bristled Boar
silver_branch_m02.subtitle: Mission 2 — Hunt
silver_branch_m02.summary: A boar with bristles like iron nails leads a herd through the fields of Dún Bera and keeps the folk from the ogham stone at the ford. Raise hounds of your own, cross the river, hunt the boar and cut the summer ogham again.
newDecisions: Buy or bargain on the road

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: Dún Bera’s fields are ploughed up — not by ploughs. A boar the size of a bull, bristles like nails, and a herd behind it.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: The ogham stone at the ford still holds the summer’s name. Someone wants it unreadable.

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: Hounds, then. Build the den, Orla. The cú sith have hunted bigger pigs than this one.

victory.speaker: Sadb
victory.text: Two fires lit. The bards say the next is at the loch of the water-horses, and the water-horses have stopped coming to the shore.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m02.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: There — the fields are ploughed in a ring around the ogham stone. They are guarding it.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: Then it still matters to them. Good.

lines.speaker: Dubhghall
lines.text: Gore her, iron-back. Plough her under with the summer.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: The boar is down. The herd is running for the woods.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Let them run. A boar without a master is only a boar.

sites.name: Dún Bera
sites.description: A farming fort on the river.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Hill of the Watchers
sites.description: From the top, the land beyond the river lies open.

sites.name: A Feather-cloak Weaver
sites.description: An old woman weaving a cloak of raven feathers.

kind.title: The Feather-cloak Weaver
kind.text: “The ravens bring me their feathers,” the old woman says, “because I tell them the news.” She holds up a finished cloak, black and shining. “It makes the road shorter. Or sit with me, and I will tell you what the ravens told me about that boar.”

options.label: Buy the raven cloak
options.summary: Pay 2,000 Gold for the Raven-feather Cloak.

sites.name: Hound Hollow
sites.description: Cú sith that have not fled the boar.

sites.name: Stepping Stones
sites.description: The stepping stones over the river, held by reavers.

sites.name: Boar’s Bed
sites.description: A hollow under an oak, where a shield lies half-buried.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: Ogham Stone of the Ford
sites.description: The standing stone that carries the summer’s name in ogham.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Cut the summer ogham again? This completes The Iron-Bristled Boar.

objectives.title: Hounds of our own

objectives.title: Climb the watchers’ hill
objectives.description: Climb Hill of the Watchers to see the land beyond the river.

objectives.title: Take the stepping stones

objectives.title: Hunt the iron-bristled boar

objectives.hint: The herd roams the fields beyond the river and only charges a war-band it is sure it can beat. Move onto it to fight.

objectives.title: Cut the summer ogham

objectives.title: The feather-cloak weaver (optional)
objectives.description: An old woman weaving a cloak of raven feathers.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Wandering bands
helpTopics.text: A wandering band stays near its hunting ground, moves after your turn and attacks only an army it judges clearly weaker. Move onto it to fight it.

helpTopics.title: Lookouts
helpTopics.text: Climbing a lookout marks distant sites on your map, so you can plan a route before you can see them.

helpTopics.title: Creature camps
helpTopics.text: A camp sells its creatures to a visiting hero at their normal price. Its stock grows every week.

silver_branch_m03.name: The Water-Horse Bargain
silver_branch_m03.subtitle: Mission 3 — Covenant
silver_branch_m03.summary: The kelpies of Loch Eala have stopped coming to shore. Break the reavers on the hill road, free the banshees’ hill from the cairn-men, win the kelpie covenant — by the keeper’s bargain or by force — and take a god for the dark road ahead.

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: The water-horses of Loch Eala carry anyone who keeps the old covenant with them. Nobody has seen one since Samhain.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: A covenant can be broken, bought or stolen. If they have stopped coming, someone holds it who should not.

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: And the banshees on Keening Hill have gone silent. A silent banshee is worse than a wailing one.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The covenant holds, a god rides with us and the hill fire is lit. The road goes west from here — to the sea.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m03.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: The banshees are keening again. I never thought I would be glad of that sound.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: They are keening for the year. Let them.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: The ring the keeper’s son got — it is here, on the shore. Grey iron, cold as a grave.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: The Withered King pays in grave-iron. I will remember.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: A god rides with us now. Whatever holds the dark half of the year, it will not meet us alone.

sites.name: Ráth Eala
sites.description: A ringfort above the loch.

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: Bards’ Hoard
sites.description: A bard’s chest hidden in a rock cleft.

sites.name: Hill Road
sites.description: The only road over the hill, held by reavers.

sites.name: Keening Hill
sites.description: The banshees’ hill. Cairn-men — stones that walk — stand around it like jailers.

sites.name: Crystal Deposit
sites.description: An unowned crystal outcrop. Capture for +1 Crystal per day.

sites.name: The Keeper of the Loch
sites.description: An old woman sits on the shore, combing a horse’s mane that is not there.

kind.title: The Keeper of the Loch
kind.text: “The covenant was sold,” the keeper says, combing. “By my own son, to a grey king for a ring. Buy it back from me at the price he got, and the horses will come to your hand. Or go down to the Kelpies’ Shore and take it from them — they will enjoy the struggle.”

options.label: Pay the keeper’s price
options.summary: Pay 1,500 Gold, 10 Wood: gain the covenant.

options.label: Refuse — take it at the shore
options.summary: Nothing is paid. The covenant must be won at Kelpies’ Shore.

sites.name: Kelpies’ Shore
sites.description: The shore where the water-horses come out of the loch.

sites.name: Causeway of Stones
sites.description: A causeway over the bog, held by reavers and their boars.

sites.name: Hill Fire
sites.description: The beacon where the year’s fires are passed from hill to hill.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Light the hill fire? This completes The Water-Horse Bargain.

objectives.title: Take the hill road
objectives.description: Defeat 16 Brigands, 6 Brigand Cutthroats at Hill Road.

objectives.title: Free Keening Hill
objectives.description: Drive 5 Clay Golems out of Keening Hill.

objectives.title: The kelpie covenant
objectives.description: Win the kelpie covenant: pay the keeper’s price on the shore of the loch, or beat the kelpies at their shore.
objectives.hint: Both routes give the same covenant. The fight gives experience; the bargain saves troops. Assign the covenant to your town to build its dwelling.

objectives.title: A god for the dark road
objectives.description: Build the Temple’s second level and commit to a first minor god (20 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: Open the Pantheon screen once the Temple stands at its second level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Battle banshees in the war-band
objectives.description: Have at least 2 Battle Banshees in Orla’s army.
objectives.hint: Build the tier-4 dwelling and its upgrade, then recruit or train.

objectives.title: Light the hill fire
objectives.description: Cross Causeway of Stones and, with a god chosen and the elite in the army, pay 500 Gold and 2 Crystal at Hill Fire.

objectives.title: The bards’ hoard (optional)
objectives.description: A bard’s chest hidden in a rock cleft.

helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: Covenants

helpTopics.title: The first minor god

silver_branch_m04.name: The Hall Beneath the Waves
silver_branch_m04.subtitle: Mission 4 — Seek
silver_branch_m04.summary: The hall of the sea-folk lies beyond the islands, behind a mist that came with the raiders. Raise selkies of your own, take the landing, light both headland fires to burn away the mist and ask the sea-folk where the Withered King keeps the broken branch.
newDecisions: Light two fires to open a way

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: The sea-folk see everything that goes into the sea. If the silver branch was thrown into the water, they know where it went.

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: A mist came in with the grey raiders and it has not lifted since. Their captain, Corc, walks the islands.

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: The old headland fires burn through any mist. Light both and the sea has to clear.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The sea-folk saw it: the branch, broken, carried into a mound in the east by the Withered King himself. And a usurper on the high seat at the ford keeps the road to it.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m04.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: Grey raiders, grey sails, grey mist. Even their blood looks grey.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Then Corc is close. Keep the war-band together.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: The mist is lifting off the water like breath off a cow.

lines.speaker: Dubhghall
lines.text: Ask the sea, druid. The sea keeps what it is given — and so do I.

sites.name: Inis Rón

sites.name: Sawmill
sites.description: An unowned timber camp. Capture for +2 Wood per day.

sites.name: Quarry
sites.description: An unowned quarry. Capture for +2 Stone per day.

sites.name: A Bard by the Shore
sites.description: A bard sitting on an upturned boat, tuning a harp.

kind.title: The Bard
kind.text: “You are going to the sea-hall,” the bard says, not looking up from the harp. “Ask your question as a verse — the sea-folk answer verses.” He tosses you a small ring of white stone. “A fairy ring. Or sit, and I will teach you the verse.”

options.label: Take the fairy ring
options.summary: The Fairy-ring Band joins Orla’s backpack.

options.label: Learn the verse

sites.name: Wrecked Currach

sites.name: Island Landing
sites.description: The landing on the near island, held by grey raiders.

sites.name: The Raiders’ Longboat
sites.description: A raider boat beached and empty.

kind.title: The Raiders’ Longboat
kind.text: The longboat is full of plunder from every coast — and a pen of great green hounds the raiders stole and never dared to let out.

options.label: Let the hounds out
options.summary: 6 Great Cú Sith join Orla’s war-band.

sites.name: North Headland Fire
sites.description: An old fire-pit on the northern headland.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light North Headland Fire? Both together open The Grey Mist.

sites.name: South Headland Fire
sites.description: An old fire-pit on the southern headland.

kind.label: relay
kind.confirmText: Light South Headland Fire? Both together open The Grey Mist.

sites.name: Ogres’ Sea-cave
sites.description: Two ogres living on wreck-pickings.

sites.name: The Grey Mist
sites.description: A wall of mist over the western sea. Both headland fires must burn to clear it.

sites.name: Hall Beneath the Waves
sites.description: The sea-folk’s hall, its doors kept by selkies who no longer remember their own skins.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Ask the sea-folk in verse? This completes The Hall Beneath the Waves.

objectives.title: The north headland fire
objectives.description: Light North Headland Fire (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The south headland fire
objectives.description: Light South Headland Fire (250 Gold, 3 Stone).

objectives.title: The bard by the shore (optional)
objectives.description: A bard sitting on an upturned boat, tuning a harp.

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: A commanded patrol
helpTopics.text: Corc takes one ordinary turn after yours each day, cannot see through fog and keeps to the land between the two waters.

helpTopics.title: Two lights, one gate
helpTopics.text: The Grey Mist opens only when both lights burn. Either order works.

silver_branch_m05.name: The High Seat
silver_branch_m05.subtitle: Mission 5 — Rival
silver_branch_m05.summary: Fiachra took the high seat at the ford in the long winter and holds it with the Withered King’s help. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his fort and overturn the inauguration stone that names him king.

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: Fiachra was a cattle-lord on the eastern ford. When the summer failed he sat on the high seat and said the winter was his to keep.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: His inauguration stone names him king. While it stands, the land answers to him — and he answers to the Withered King.

briefing.speaker: Fiachra
briefing.text: Go back to your groves, druid. A winter king is still a king, and I keep my people fed.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The stone is overturned and the land is free of his kingship. The road east to the mound is open.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m05.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: We are over. His cattle-scouts will be running home.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Let them run. I want him to hear it from his own people.

lines.speaker: Fiachra
lines.text: My people eat this winter. Will they eat in your summer?

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: They ate in every summer before you.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Dún Fiachra is ours. And look — the stone of the kings was in his treasury. Now the inauguration stone.

objectives.title: Cross the river
objectives.description: Clear either crossing: Cairn Ford (8 Clay Golems) or Reaver Ford (24 Brigands, 10 Brigand Cutthroats).
objectives.hint: Either crossing is enough. Fiachra’s army can use a cleared crossing too.

objectives.title: A second god
objectives.description: Raise the Civic Hall’s third level and commit to a second minor god (25 Favor, irreversible).
objectives.hint: The second god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level. A god chosen earlier counts as soon as this step opens.

objectives.title: Take Dún Fiachra
objectives.description: Besiege and take Dún Fiachra.
objectives.hint: Fiachra is a full empire run by the AI: it builds, recruits and may come for your town. Its town is garrisoned even when the hero rides out.

objectives.title: Defeat Fiachra (optional)

objectives.title: The salmon pool (optional)

helpTopics.title: Steps in order
helpTopics.text: Each primary step opens after the one before it. Work done early still counts: a step whose goal is already met completes the moment it opens.

helpTopics.title: A rival empire
helpTopics.text: Dún Fiachra is a full empire run by the AI with the same rules as yours: it builds, recruits, takes mines and may besiege Dún Ard. Losing Dún Ard does not end the mission; losing Orla does.

helpTopics.title: The second god
helpTopics.text: A second minor god needs the first, the Temple’s second level and the Civic Hall’s third level, and costs 25 Favor.

helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. Walls and towers favour the defender; shooters fire over them.

silver_branch_m06.name: The Stags’ Wood
silver_branch_m06.subtitle: Mission 6 — Refuge
silver_branch_m06.summary: The great horned stags of the deep wood are bound in iron by the Withered King’s jailers. Break the jailers, accept the stags’ covenant, raise stag spirits of your own and defeat Tadhg the Grey at the wood’s gate.
newDecisions: Claim a covenant from the journal

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: The horned stags lead the year from the dark half to the bright. No one has heard them bell since Samhain.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: The Withered King has bound them in grave-iron in their own wood. Free them, and the year can turn.

briefing.speaker: Sadb
briefing.text: His champion holds the wood’s gate. Tadhg the Grey. He was a hero once.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The stags are belling. Tonight, from the edge of the wood, I saw the mound in the east — and the summer stone and the winter stone on either side of the road to it.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m06.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: The iron is off. They will not follow us for that — stags follow covenants, not favours.

lines.speaker: Cathal
lines.text: Then make them one, Orla. They are waiting.

lines.speaker: Dubhghall
lines.text: Tadhg was the greatest of the fian once. Now he is mine. So is everything that grows old enough.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: Tadhg is down. He thanked me, Orla, at the end.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: Then he is free too.

kind.text: The band is grave-iron, cold enough to burn. Cut it, and the fawn will run to its mother. Or melt it in a druid fire and read the king’s secrets in the smoke.

helpTopics.title: Claiming a covenant
helpTopics.text: Some rewards wait in the journal until you accept them. Accept the covenant there, then assign it to a town.

silver_branch_m07.name: The Door of the Mound
silver_branch_m07.subtitle: Mission 7 — Finale
silver_branch_m07.summary: The Withered King holds the broken silver branch in his hall inside the great mound. Cross the barrow-hills, use the summer stone and the winter stone to open the door, defeat Dubhghall and decide what becomes of the silver branch.

briefing.speaker: Orla
briefing.text: The great mound. Every door to the Otherworld opened from here once — at Samhain and at Beltane. The Withered King has made it his hall, and he keeps the broken branch inside.

briefing.speaker: Cathal
briefing.text: The summer stone and the winter stone open the door, one on each side of the barrow-road. Ciar the warden walks between them.

briefing.speaker: Dubhghall
briefing.text: Come in, druid. The dark half is long, and I have room for you in it.

victory.speaker: Orla
victory.text: The year has turned. I felt it — like a door swinging open in a warm wind.

debriefPolicy: Orla keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
The Dagda and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, forts, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to hold the land.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
silver_branch_m07.heroHiringDisabledReason: Orla rides with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The Silver Branch.

lines.speaker: Sadb
lines.text: The door is open. I can smell apple blossom from inside — in this cold.

lines.speaker: Dubhghall
lines.text: Every summer ends, druid. I only made sure of it.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: And every winter ends. I am here to make sure of that.

lines.speaker: Orla
lines.text: He is gone. The branch is here, in two halves. One last thing to decide.

sites.name: The Silver Branch

kind.title: The Silver Branch
kind.text: With the Withered King gone, the two halves of the branch lie before you. Mended, it will open the mounds as it always did — the Otherworld close, the old folk walking the roads at Samhain and Beltane. Planted, the halves will grow into a new tree; its branches will open the mounds only for those who seek them, and the old folk will grow rarer every year.

options.label: Mend the branch
options.summary: The mounds open as they always did. Orla gains 500 experience.

options.label: Plant the branch
options.summary: A new tree, and a quieter Otherworld. Orla gains 500 experience.

sites.name: Fire of the Year
sites.description: The fire-pit where the year’s turning is kindled.

kind.label: beacon
kind.confirmText: Kindle the fire of the year? This completes The Silver Branch.

objectives.title: Kindle the fire of the year

helpTopics.title: The last choice
helpTopics.text: The last choice changes the ending you see, not the reward: both complete the campaign.

new_fire_m01.name: The Cold Altar
new_fire_m01.subtitle: Mission 1 — Restore
new_fire_m01.summary: On the night the years are bound, the new fire was never lit — someone put out the old one first. Raise a war-band of feathered serpents in Xochitla, clear the canoe ford and kindle the fire on the hill altar.
newDecisions: Learn spells at the Mage Guild

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
briefing.text: Fifty-two years, and the night came to bind them. We broke the old pots, put out every hearth and waited for the fire from the hill. It never came.

briefing.speaker: Itzel
briefing.text: Then the fire-drill never turned. Someone stopped the priests before the new fire could be drilled. The hill altar is where it starts.

briefing.speaker: Chimal
briefing.text: Men in black paint hold the hill. And the canoe ford is full of peccaries gone mad with hunger. I will carry the shield, day-keeper.

victory.speaker: Itzel
victory.text: The new fire burns on the hill, and the runners are carrying it to the hearths. But only here. The sun was paler again this morning.

debriefPolicy: Itzel keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Quetzalcoatl and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, cities, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to keep the fires.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
new_fire_m01.heroHiringDisabledReason: Itzel carries the fire with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The New Fire.

lines.speaker: Chimal
lines.text: Someone penned those pigs in the ford and starved them. Cruel, and on purpose.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: Then someone wanted the hill kept clear. The altar, then.

lines.speaker: Itztli
lines.text: Little day-keeper. The count is finished. No new fire, no new years. Let the sun go out like a tired hearth.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: I have not finished counting.

lines.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
lines.text: Their leader wore this — the quetzal crown from the temple of Xochitla. It was stolen at the binding.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: A temple crown on a cultist. Whoever pays them has walked in our temples.

lines.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
lines.text: We counted our dead today, Itzel. The count is longer than I like.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: Then I will count more carefully.

kind.text: The brazier lies in the mud and the copal has burned to nothing. Around it, four small feathered serpents coil in the ashes, as if waiting to be told where the fire went.

helpTopics.title: Dwelling upgrade vs. troop training

helpTopics.title: One-time choices
helpTopics.text: Some places offer a choice the first time a hero arrives. The result of each option is shown before you choose, and the choice cannot be taken back.

helpTopics.title: Offering
helpTopics.text: The Mesoamerican signature: once per week in each city with a Temple, creatures from the garrison or the visiting hero can be offered for Favor.

new_fire_m02.name: The Black Jaguars
new_fire_m02.subtitle: Mission 2 — Hunt
new_fire_m02.summary: A pack of black jaguar spirits, loosed by the Night-Knife, hunts the cacao groves of Tepeyolo and guards the altar of the morning star. Raise jaguars of your own, cross the river, hunt the pack down and relight the altar.
newDecisions: Buy or bargain on the road

briefing.speaker: Chimal
briefing.text: Tepeyolo’s cacao pickers will not go into the groves. Black jaguars — not the spotted kind — and they do not eat what they kill.

briefing.speaker: Itzel
briefing.text: The altar of the morning star is beyond the groves. If the morning star has no fire, the sun has no herald.

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
briefing.text: Jaguars of our own, then. Build them a house, child. Jaguars respect their own kind.

victory.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
victory.text: Two altars lit. The old eagle knights say the next fire belongs to the House of Eagles in the mountains — and that the eagles have stopped flying.

debriefPolicy: Itzel keeps her level, experience (up to the displayed cap), skills, spellbook, spells and equipment.
Quetzalcoatl and every god she has committed to carry into the next mission.
Troops, resources, cities, mines and recruitment pools stay behind to keep the fires.
The next mission begins with its declared war-band and treasury.
new_fire_m02.heroHiringDisabledReason: Itzel carries the fire with her own war-band. Hero hiring is disabled in The New Fire.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: There — the groves are trampled in a ring around the altar. They are guarding it.

lines.speaker: Chimal
lines.text: Then it still matters to someone. Good.

lines.speaker: Itztli
lines.text: Hunt her, my black ones. Night belongs to jaguars.

lines.speaker: Chimal
lines.text: The pack is broken. The last of them ran for the hills.

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: Let them. Without the Night-Knife’s voice they are only cats.

helpTopics.title: Wandering bands
helpTopics.text: A wandering band stays near its hunting ground, moves after your turn and attacks only an army it judges clearly weaker. Move onto it to fight it.

helpTopics.title: Lookouts
helpTopics.text: Climbing a lookout marks distant sites on your map, so you can plan a route before you can see them.

helpTopics.title: Creature camps
helpTopics.text: A camp sells its creatures to a visiting hero at their normal price. Its stock grows every week.

new_fire_m03.name: The House of Eagles
new_fire_m03.subtitle: Mission 3 — Covenant
new_fire_m03.summary: The eagle warriors of Ocelotepec have stopped flying. Break the cultists on the mountain road, free the crocodiles’ cenote from the stone jailers, win the eagle covenant — by the elders’ price or by force — and take a god for the dark road ahead.

briefing.speaker: Chimal
briefing.text: The eagle warriors fly for whoever keeps the covenant of the House of Eagles. For a month they have only perched.

briefing.speaker: Itzel
briefing.text: A covenant can be kept, sold or stolen. If they do not fly for us, someone else holds it.

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
briefing.text: And the crocodiles of the sacred cenote have sunk to the bottom. A cenote without its guardians is only a hole.

victory.speaker: Itzel
victory.text: The covenant holds, a god walks with us and the mountain fire burns. From here the road goes down to the great lake.

lines.speaker: Itzel

new_fire_m04.summary: The House of Bats stands on an island in the great lake, behind a smoke that came with the raiders’ canoes. Raise camazotz of your own, take the landing, light both lake altars to clear the smoke and ask the bats where the Night-Knife keeps the stolen fire.

briefing.speaker: Itzel
briefing.text: The bats see everything that moves at night. If the Night-Knife carried the old fire away, the bats watched him go.

briefing.speaker: Chimal
briefing.text: A smoke has lain on the lake since the canoe raiders came. Their captain, Acatl, walks the islands.

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
briefing.text: The two lake altars burn through any smoke — the old priests built them so. Light both and the lake must clear.

victory.speaker: Itzel
victory.text: The bats saw him: the Night-Knife, carrying the old fire into the smoking mountain in the east. And a city lord at Itzcalli holds the road for him.

lines.speaker: Chimal

lines.speaker: Itzel
lines.text: Then Acatl is close. Keep the war-band together.

lines.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
lines.text: The smoke is lifting off the water like mist at sunrise. The old priests knew their work.

lines.speaker: Itztli
lines.text: Ask the bats, day-keeper. They will tell you the night is longer than the day. It always was.

new_fire_m05.subtitle: Mission 5 — Rival
new_fire_m05.summary: Tecuani, lord of Itzcalli, swore to the Night-Knife for the throne of the next age, and holds the road east. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his city and break the stela of his oath.

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco
briefing.text: Tecuani was a good lord once. When the fire went out, the Night-Knife promised him the throne of the next age, and he believed it.

briefing.speaker: Itzel
briefing.text: The oath-stela in his city binds him to the Night-Knife — and binds the road east to both of them. It has to fall.

briefing.speaker: Tecuani
briefing.text: Go back to your counting, day-keeper. Every age ends. I only want to be standing when the next one begins.

victory.speaker: Itzel
victory.text: The stela is broken and the road east is open. Tecuani has nothing left but the Night-Knife’s promise — and so do we, except that we know where the fire is.

briefing.speaker: Chimal
briefing.text: The turquoise fire serpents carry the flame across the sky. Since the binding night they have not been seen.

briefing.speaker: Itzel

briefing.speaker: Grandmother Xoco

helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. The Fort gives walls and a gate, the Citadel adds a keep and a moat, the Castle stronger walls and two towers. Your Catapult removes one structure point at the start of every round: the gate first, or the section you aim it at on your turn. Cyclopes can batter the walls instead of shooting. The keep and towers fire at the stack their shot hurts most, shooters first. helpTopics.title: Sieges
helpTopics.text: Entering an enemy town that has a garrison or a visiting hero starts a siege. The Fort gives walls and a gate, the Citadel adds a keep and a moat, the Castle stronger walls and two towers. Your Catapult removes one structure point at the start of every round: the gate first, or the section you aim it at on your turn. Cyclopes can batter the walls instead of shooting. The keep and towers fire at the stack their shot hurts most, shooters first. The defender may combine identical stacks, then chooses at most seven; the rest wait in reserve and are lost if the town falls. A town defender cannot retreat or surrender. Values are proposed.

skirmish_twin_harbors.name: Twin Harbors
skirmish_twin_harbors.tagline: Two harbors, one gold mine between them.
skirmish_twin_harbors.summary: Two harbor towns face each other along a small stretch of coast. Between them lies a guarded gold mine — whoever holds it pulls ahead. Choose your pantheon and the rival’s; the rival is played by the AI or by a second player on this computer.
highlights: A short game for two empires on a small map.
The guarded gold mine lies halfway between the towns.
Any pantheon against any pantheon.

frostgate.name: Frostgate
frostgate.tagline: Two fjord valleys, one pass, and the key on the ice.
frostgate.summary: Two empires face each other across a frozen fjord. The only way between them is a pass through the ridge, shut by twin crimson gates. Each empire’s crimson key lies on its own glacier island, reached by portal and guarded by nesting wyverns — whoever takes the key first decides when the war begins.
highlights: One pass, barred by two crimson key gates.
Each empire’s key waits on a glacier island, reached by portal.
Icy spray: the fjord climate in every battle.

burning_oasis.name: The Burning Oasis
burning_oasis.tagline: Four empires, four oases, one shrine in the fire.
burning_oasis.summary: Four empires hold the corners of a burning desert. Between each pair of neighbours lies an oasis: the northern and southern ones hide gold mines, the eastern and western ones crystal, and every oasis keeps a creature camp. At the centre, ringed by red rock, stands the Burning Shrine — hold it for seven days, or conquer every rival.
highlights: Four empires; every neighbour shares an oasis with you.
Hold the Burning Shrine seven days to win.
Scorching sand slows ground troops in battle.

circle_of_gates.name: The Circle of Gates
circle_of_gates.tagline: Three valleys and a ring of portals: every rival is at your back door.
circle_of_gates.summary: Three high valleys surround a peak sanctum with spell shrines and a crown on its summit, reached by guarded paths. Ridges with one guarded crossing part the valleys. A ring of portals links them: each home gate opens behind the next empire’s town, and each back gate leads to the previous empire’s home.
highlights: A ring of six portals: raid your neighbour’s back — and watch your own.
Three spell shrines and the Crown of the Summit in the sanctum.
Thin air: the high-pass climate in every battle.

barrows.name: Barrows of the Lost Kings
barrows.tagline: A fog moor of burial mounds, captive heroes and sealed hoards.
barrows.summary: A fog-bound moor scattered with barrows. In each empire’s nearest barrow a hero of its own people waits to be freed; in the King’s Barrows wait veterans. Hermits pay for deeds, and two hoards sealed behind amber and violet gates open only for their keys — one kept in each empire’s back country. Gold is scarce: one mine each.
highlights: Prisons with captive heroes, guarded by barrow-wights.
Amber and violet key vaults with major artifacts.
Scarce gold and moorland fog.

golden_fords.name: The Golden Fords
golden_fords.tagline: A rich valley between two rivers. Fast, open, and generous.
golden_fords.summary: A golden autumn valley between two rivers, with three guarded fords across each. The fields between the rivers hold gold and crystal mines, a mill, camps and the Horn of Plenty. Every empire starts with twice the usual treasury and the whole map revealed: a fast, open game and a good first skirmish.
highlights: Twice the usual treasury; the map is revealed.
Three guarded fords on each river.
The Horn of Plenty between the rivers.

six_thrones.name: The Six Thrones
six_thrones.tagline: Six empires, one island, one shrine.
six_thrones.summary: One island shared by six thrones. Each empire holds a wedge of land between two ridges, with one guarded pass to each neighbour and one guarded path to the Shrine at the island’s heart. Hold the Shrine for ten days, or be the last throne standing. Seats left to the AI play as AI empires.
highlights: Six empires; every seat human or AI.
Hold the Shrine of Six Thrones ten days to win.
Guarded ridge passes to both neighbours.
